1314.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Valve，反恐精英：全球攻势

1:0.desc_en: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range.
1:0.desc_zh: 杀伤力和它的卖价一样高，沙漠之鹰是一把很难驾驭，而在远距离又出乎意料精准的经典手枪。

1:1006.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 午夜凶匪
1:1006.desc_en:
Its base has been painted with a purple anodized map pattern. It looks like someone has drawn on top of the map since it was first applied.

Planning is one thing, executing is another
1:1006.desc_zh:
枪身饰有紫色电镀地图花纹，宛如手工绘制一般。

计划是计划，执行是执行。

1:1050.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 后发制人
1:1050.desc_en:
A pink isometric pattern has been custom painted on the barrel. The hammer and front sight have been painted bright blue.

Patience is its own reward
1:1050.desc_zh:
这把武器采用自定义涂装，枪管上绘制了粉色的等距图案。击锤和前准星处均以亮蓝色喷涂。

耐心本身就是回报

1:1054.desc_en:
It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone
1:1054.desc_zh:
通过木炭在高温下的应用，这把武器已被彩色表面淬火。

一点彩色痕迹无伤大雅

1:1056.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 人造卫星
1:1056.desc_en:
A space themed pattern consisting of stars and satellites has been applied.

Send and receive
1:1056.desc_zh:
这把武器绘有太空主题的星星和卫星图案。

发送并接收

1:1090.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 纵横波涛
1:1090.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using oversaturated colors and different shapes.

Can't miss—both the colors and when using the weapon
1:1090.desc_zh:
这把武器采用过饱和的颜色和不同的形状进行了自定义涂装。

无论是使用颜色还是枪械——都不容有失

1:114.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 书法涂鸦
1:114.desc_en:
The slide of this Desert Eagle has been decorated with silver paint pen calligraphy.

These things take time
1:114.desc_zh:
这把沙漠之鹰的套筒上用银色油漆笔书法进行了装饰。

好事多磨

1:1189.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 巨蟒冲击
1:1189.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with an orange and red snakeskin pattern.

Serpentine!
1:1189.desc_zh:
它采用了橙红蟒皮涂装。

蛇皮走位！

1:1257.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 薄荷折扇
1:1257.desc_en:
A teal and brown halftone fan pattern has been applied.

Let's clear the air
1:1257.desc_zh:
它采用了青褐半调扇形涂装。

让我们澄清一下

1:1318.desc_en:
It has been painted with a deep, satin finish purple color.

"It's fuchsia, spelled f-u-c-h-s-i-a"
1:1318.desc_zh:
它采用了深邃绸缎紫色涂装。

“这叫紫红色，跟我读：紫-红-色”

1:1360.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 每日鹰爆
1:1360.desc_en:
A grayscale pattern has been applied.

From the pages of your favorite graphic novel
1:1360.desc_zh:
采用了灰度图案涂装。

取自你最爱的漫画书页

1:138.desc_en:
Its aqua-colored base has been tagged with graffiti from different artists.

"I want EVERY round"
1:138.desc_zh:
水绿色的枪底上覆盖了不同艺术家的涂鸦标记。

“我想赢下每一局”

1:1430.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 霜寒之焰
1:1430.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with purple and blue flames using pearlescent paint.

Contains exceptional qualities and abilities
1:1430.desc_zh:
使用珠光漆定制涂装了紫色和蓝色的火焰。

蕴含超凡品质与威能

1:1458.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 东方之谜
1:1458.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a metallic silver, black, and blue design.

Don't lose the thread
1:1458.desc_zh:
它采用了金属银、黑、蓝三色设计进行定制涂装。

别丢了线头

1:17.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 都市 DDPAT
1:17.desc_en:
It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late
1:17.desc_zh:
这把武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

当你能注意到像素图案的时候，已经为时已晚了

1:185.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 黄金锦鲤
1:185.desc_en:
This memento from Chinatown has been covered in a metallic foil with a scale pattern.

A loud gun in every sense of the word
1:185.desc_zh:
这把来自火拼华埠的纪念武器覆上了金属箔，然后使用鳞纹图案进行了涂装。

从任何字眼上来解读都是一把“高调”的枪

1:231.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 钴蓝禁锢
1:231.desc_en: It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a digital disruptive pattern.
1:231.desc_zh: 这把武器覆上了印有数字迷彩图案的金属箔。

1:232.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 深红之网
1:232.desc_en:
It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread
1:232.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色为外表，使用蜘蛛网图案的花纹进行了涂装，完毕后再配上了半光的表层。

留意你的脚步，你永远都不会知道蛛网撒在何处

1:237.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 都市瓦砾
1:237.desc_en:
It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction
1:237.desc_zh:
这把武器使用多变迷彩图案花纹进行了涂装。

没有毁灭，哪来重生

1:273.collection_name_zh: 军火交易 3 号收藏品
1:273.desc_en: It has been hand engraved and inlaid with a scroll pattern.
1:273.desc_zh: 这把武器进行了手工雕刻，并使用卷轴图案加以镶嵌。

1:296.desc_en:
It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact
1:296.desc_zh:
枪身涂有金属质感喷漆并使用结晶模具压印图案。

谁都想做弄潮儿

1:328.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 手上加农炮
1:328.desc_en:
It has brass parts that have been given an acid patina inspired by antique brass cannons.

Be prepared to encounter many thorns in the trials to come
1:328.desc_zh:
受仿古铜炮启发，这把武器的黄铜部件被附上了强酸处理的铜绿。

准备好在即将到来的试炼中接受更多的挫折与挑战吧

1:347.desc_en:
It has a brass inlay of a pilot's wings.

Assume crash positions
1:347.desc_zh:
我把武器使用飞行员的机翼图案，以黄铜进行了镶嵌。

做好坠机姿势

1:351.desc_en: It has been painted with dark, metallic paint and pale yellow accents.
1:351.desc_zh: 这把武器使用黑色、金属涂料和淡黄色调进行了涂装。

1:37.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 炽烈之炎
1:37.desc_en: It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints over a chrome base coat.
1:37.desc_zh: 这把武器以铬为外表，使用喷笔涂上了透明涂装。

1:397.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 纳迦蛇神
1:397.desc_en:
It has been engraved with a mythological motif.

A beast in Indian mythology as well as on the battlefield
1:397.desc_zh:
这把武器雕刻了神话主题的图案。

是印第安神话的野兽，也是战地野兽

1:40.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 噩梦之夜
1:40.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck
1:40.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以黑夜行动的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

疑是清风，却是封喉…

1:425.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 青铜装饰
1:425.desc_en:
It has been painted in an art deco pattern using metallic automotive paints.

Everyone's searching for silver and gold
1:425.desc_zh:
这把武器使用艺术装饰图案，搭配金属汽车的涂料进行了涂装。

每个人都在寻觅着白银和黄金

1:468.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 午夜风暴
1:468.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a blue metallic base coat.

I don't hate you Sebastien... I pity you - Chase Turner, Coalition Defector
1:468.desc_zh:
这把武器以蓝色金属为外表，使用惊涛骇浪的花纹进行了自定义涂装。

我不恨你，塞巴斯蒂安… 我只是同情你 - 联合特遣队叛逃者蔡斯.特纳

1:469.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 日落风暴 壱
1:469.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a red metallic base coat.

You think it's the same, but look again... subtlety makes all the difference
1:469.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色金属为外表，使用惊涛骇浪的花纹进行了自定义涂装。

你以为它看上去相同，但再看一遍…… 细节足以决定所有的差异

1:470.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 日落风暴 弐
1:470.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a red metallic base coat.

You think it's the same, but look again... subtlety makes all the difference
1:470.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色金属为外表，使用惊涛骇浪的花纹进行了自定义涂装。

你以为它看上去相同，但再看一遍…… 细节足以决定所有的差异

1:509.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 科林斯遗产
1:509.desc_en:
It has been laser-etched and given a custom leather grip.

Protect. Hope. Trust. Persevere.
1:509.desc_zh:
这把武器使用了激光蚀刻，然后被附上了一层定制的皮革握把。

守护。希望。信任。坚韧。

1:527.desc_en:
Dragons have been laser-etched onto the slide and grip.

I'm a big fan of your work Yukako, we should talk... -Huxley, The Competition
1:527.desc_zh:
巨龙的图案被激光蚀刻在滑套和握把上。

友佳子，我特别欣赏你做出来的武器，我们应该谈谈… -竞争者赫胥黎

1:603.desc_en:
It has been designed to help the future of law enforcement stop creeps.

Your move...
1:603.desc_zh:
这件武器是设计来帮助未来的执法者阻止变态小人。

该你了...

1:61.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 蛊惑之色
1:61.desc_en:
It has been painted with a pearl base coat, then spray-painted black through a stencil in a graphic pattern.

You're not getting sleepy, you're passing out from blood loss
1:61.desc_zh:
这把武器使用珍珠外表进行了涂装，然后配上图案，通过漏字板漆上了黑色。

你此时的昏昏沉沉是失血过多的表现

1:645.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 锈蚀烈焰
1:645.desc_en:
A custom paint job has been applied with a rust-colored base and white detailing.

Nothing a little sandpaper can't fix
1:645.desc_zh:
这把武器运用了生锈底色与白色细节点缀的定绘。

没有什么是砂纸修复不了的

1:711.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 红色代号
1:711.desc_en:
A custom paint job with a bright red base and white detailing has been applied.

Man your stations
1:711.desc_zh:
武器上绘制着红底白纹的图案。

各就各位

1:757.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 翡翠巨蟒
1:757.desc_en:
A green pattern depicting Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, has been applied.

Wake the gods
1:757.desc_zh:
这把武器使用了自定义涂装，用绿色图案描绘了耶加梦得——世界之蛇。

惊醒众神

1:764.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 沙漠之狐
1:764.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a fennec fox on the barrel. The grip features teal and orange designs.

All the better to hear you with
1:764.desc_zh:
这把武器的枪管上绘有沙漠之狐的自定义涂装。握把上有蓝绿色和橙色的图案。

聆听者的素养

1:805.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 机械工业
1:805.desc_en:
Its white and black design feels both sterile and futuristic.

Same technology, now available in a smaller form factor
1:805.desc_zh:
枪身黑色和白色的图案，虽缺乏生气却彰显未来感。

相同技术，小一号尺寸现可拥有

1:841.desc_en:
Its custom paint job creates an optical illusion and appears to change the weapon's geometry.

Required power supply sold separately
1:841.desc_zh:
该定制涂装造成了一种视觉错觉，似乎改变了武器的几何结构.

电池还请另购

1:90.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 泥地杀手
1:90.desc_en: It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.
1:90.desc_zh: 这把武器被涂上了大理石纹图案。

1:938.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 星尘拱廊
1:938.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with an abstract design using metallic flake paint.

A New High Score!
1:938.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装采用了金属闪光漆进行了抽象的设计。

创纪录高分！

1:945.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 蓝色层压板
1:945.desc_en:
It has been laminated and filled with an ash-colored grip and blue slide.

WARNING: This is a replica and has not been tested with live ammunition
1:945.desc_zh:
经过层压并装有灰白色握柄与蓝色滑轨。

警告：这是仿制品，尚未经过实弹测试。

1:962.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1;
1:962.desc_zh:
这把武器使用鲜明的黑白色调设计进行了自定义涂装，最后用珍珠般高光加以点缀。

白色；黑色；珍珠色；

1:992.name_zh: 沙漠之鹰 | 古铜密码
1:992.desc_en:
A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do
1:992.desc_zh:
枪身饰有彩色数字花纹。

数字不会说谎，但我会

10:0.desc_en: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs.
10:0.desc_zh: 给手头紧的玩家的一个廉价选择，法玛斯有效地填补了昂贵的步枪和杀伤力较低的微型冲锋枪之间的空缺。

10:1053.desc_en:
It has been painted with a pattern of nuclear hazard symbols using metallic paints.

Steer clear for a while...
10:1053.desc_zh:
这把武器采用金属喷绘了核危害的符号图案。

暂时避一避……

10:1066.desc_en:
A pattern of a wiring diagram has been applied.

Please consult an electrician before conducting your own repairs
10:1066.desc_zh:
这把武器绘有布线图。

自行维修前，请咨询电工

10:1092.desc_en:
This custom paint job uses gaming PCs of old as inspiration. Its black base has been finished with multicolored accents.

Clive would be proud
10:1092.desc_zh:
这把武器以旧时的游戏电脑为灵感来源进行了自定义涂装，黑色底座采用多色加以点缀。

家用计算机先驱将以你为荣

10:1127.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with pink interlocking squares. The squares are painted with lifelike eyes.

Frantic are the eyes of the dreamer
10:1127.desc_zh:
这把武器采用紧密相连的粉色方块进行了自定义涂装，方块中绘制了栩栩如生的眼睛。

做梦的人由于眼睛过多，而陷入癫狂

10:1146.desc_en:
Its green base is emblazoned with the number 36.

Technically it's four cats, but who's counting?
10:1146.desc_zh:
这把武器以绿色为外表，辅以数字36进行装饰。

确切说，是4只猫。不过谁会真的去数呢？

10:1184.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with brightly colored monsters.

When you've had too much
10:1184.desc_zh:
它采用了炫彩怪物涂装。

当你玩得太过火时

10:1202.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a tread plate pattern and "2A2F" on the handguard.

"2A2F—reliable shipping in an unreliable world"
10:1202.desc_zh:
它被定制涂装上了防滑板图案，并且在护手上有 “2A2F” 字样。

“2A2F—— 在不可靠的世界里提供可靠运输”

10:1219.desc_en:
A blue and grey camo pattern has been applied.

Arctic camo, eh?
10:1219.desc_zh:
它采用了蓝灰极地迷彩。

北极伪装，嗯？

10:1241.name_zh: 法玛斯 | 奈芙蒂斯之河
10:1241.desc_en:
The blues on this custom painted FAMAS shift as lighting conditions change.

Water always wins
10:1241.desc_zh:
这把法玛斯上的蓝色自定义涂装会随着光照条件的变化而变化。

上善若水

10:1302.desc_en: It has been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.
10:1302.desc_zh: 这把武器以纸板切口、细网格和棕榈叶为漏字板进行了喷漆。

10:1321.desc_en:
A silver hydrographic pattern has been applied and finished with red accents.

Sterling qualities
10:1321.desc_zh:
枪身采用了银灰水转涂装搭配猩红点缀。

不朽银辉

10:1365.desc_en:
It has been painted with a woodgrain pattern using high gloss paint.

Here—an axe for you to grind... - Booth, Arms Dealer
10:1365.desc_zh:
它采用了高光漆料绘制的木纹涂装。

给你把斧子，好好磨吧…… ——军火商布兹

10:1393.desc_en:
A gold-colored burst pattern has been applied.

"Cool guys don't look at explosions"
10:1393.desc_zh:
采用了金色放射状纹理涂装。

“真男人从不回头看爆炸”

10:1461.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a green snake, highlighted by a bright gold outline over a matte gold base.

A flicker of hope
10:1461.desc_zh:
它采用哑光金色为底的定制涂装，绘有一条绿蛇，并以亮金色勾勒轮廓。

一丝希望

10:1477.desc_en:
It has been custom painted in black and red.

Suit and sunglasses sold separately
10:1477.desc_zh:
它采用黑色与红色进行定制涂装。

西装和墨镜单独出售

10:154.desc_en: It has been custom-painted with broken ribbon trails.
10:154.desc_zh: 这把武器的部分零件使用破旧的带状轨迹进行了自定义涂装。

10:178.desc_en: It has been hydro-dipped with a graphic of overlapping cat skulls.
10:178.desc_zh: 这把武器以重叠的小猫头骨形象进行了浸渍。

10:194.desc_en:
This memento from Cache has been painted with a shark's mouth in the style of aircraft nose art.

Jester's dead
10:194.desc_zh:
这把来自死城之谜的纪念武器以飞机机头艺术为风格，使用鲨鱼的嘴巴进行了涂装。

小丑已死

10:218.collection_name_zh: 军火交易 2 号收藏品
10:218.desc_en: It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.
10:218.desc_zh: 这把武器使用六边形图案的花纹进行了涂装。

10:22.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go
10:22.desc_zh:
这把武器的喷漆采用徒手绘制，线条短粗，对比色彩鲜明。

活跃叛乱者的称手武器

10:240.desc_en:
It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction
10:240.desc_zh:
这把武器使用多变迷彩图案花纹进行了涂装。

没有毁灭，哪来重生

10:244.desc_en: It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.
10:244.desc_zh: 这把武器以网格布为漏字板，徒手进行了喷漆。

10:260.desc_en:

It'll take more than a tarp to protect you
13:264.desc_zh:
这把武器使用紫色和米色的图形设计的花纹进行了涂装。

支起帐篷还不足以抵御袭击

13:294.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a green and black color scheme.

An apple a day keeps insurance premiums high
13:294.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以绿色和黑色的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

一天一苹果，保费高如天

13:297.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and white color scheme.

For when combat is a black tie affair
13:297.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以黑色和白色的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

为战斗成为正式场合而生

13:308.desc_en:
It has been painted using a hydrographic in a Japanese manga pattern.

Some ghosts won't stay buried
13:308.desc_zh:
这把武器使用日漫的图案进行了涂装。

不是所有的鬼灵都会选择长眠地下

13:379.name_zh: 加利尔AR | 地狱看门犬
13:379.desc_en: It has been custom painted with a depiction of Cerberus, the mythical three headed dog that guards the underworld.
13:379.desc_zh: 这把武器使用地狱看门犬刻画进行了自定义涂装，地狱看门犬是神话传说中守护冥界的三头犬。

13:398.desc_en:
It has been hand-painted and distressed.  The skull painted over the dust cover appears to chatter when the bolt reciprocates.

Some say that when you laugh, the world laughs with you...but when Chatterbox laughs there are only screams
13:398.desc_zh:
这把武器经过了手绘和磨损处理。随着枪栓的往复运动，防尘罩上骷髅看上去像在喋喋不休。

有人说，你笑的时候，世界也跟着笑… 但当“喧闹骷髅”笑的时候，世界只剩下尖叫

13:428.desc_en:
It has been painted white and green and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

For enough money, Elite Crew will take any cause on as their own
13:428.desc_zh:
这把武器使用白色和绿色进行了涂装，并通过热转印贴花加强细节。

只要有足够多的钱，精锐分子就会把任何目标担负在自己身上

13:460.desc_en:
It has been painted with a geometric motif in metallic paints.

Serenity now...
13:460.desc_zh:
这把武器使用金属涂料，以几何图案进行了涂装。

安静下来…

13:478.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a graphic design of stripes and pixellated particles.

The perfect thing for a hot summer's day
13:478.desc_zh:
这把武器使用条纹和像素化的图形设计进行了自定义涂装。

炎炎夏日最完美的工作

13:494.desc_en:
It has been highlighted with metallic blue paint.  The stock and magazine bare its designer's mark.

Eventually you need to step outside of your mentor's shadow
13:494.desc_zh:
这把武器使用金属蓝色涂料进行了抛光。

你终究要从导师的阴影之下迈出来

13:546.desc_en:
It has been given crimson accents and a hand painted icon.

Booth had this weapon commissioned for Valeria in an attempt to smooth things over with the Phoenix
13:546.desc_zh:
这件武器以深红装饰，并配有手绘标志。

布兹为瓦莱里娅定制了这件武器，希望能借此缓和与凤凰战士的关系

13:629.desc_en:
It has been custom pained in black and camo.

Mikah Baton is about to begin his campaign against the Coalition Taskforce
13:629.desc_zh:
这把武器使用黑色和迷彩进行了自定义涂装。

米坎.巴唐准备好发动他那针对联合特遣队的战役了

13:647.desc_en:
A spray-painted, blue wave pattern sits atop a maroon base.

Westward breaks
13:647.desc_zh:
这把武器在绛红底色上喷涂了蓝色波浪的图案。

浪卷西方

13:661.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using cotton candy themed colors and various patterns.

Prepare for the crash
13:661.desc_zh:
使用了棉花糖主题色与各种图案的定制喷涂。

准备来一场糖果粉碎传奇吧！

13:76.desc_en:
It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone
13:76.desc_zh:
这把武器使用森林迷彩花纹进行了涂装。

森林也许会是危险之地…… 不宜一人独往

13:790.desc_en:
A toxic, pale blue hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Hypotheses are never proven
13:790.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了含毒的蓝色水文图案。

假设从未被证实

13:807.desc_en:
A hydrographic pattern of red hexagons has been applied over a dark blue base.

Information is never free
13:807.desc_zh:
这把武器在深蓝色的底座上采用了红色六边形花纹图案。

情报从来就不是唾手可得

13:83.desc_en:
It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late
13:83.desc_zh:
这把武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

当你能注意到像素图案的时候，已经为时已晚了

13:842.desc_en:
A rust-colored pattern has been spray painted over a white base.

Your personal battle cry
13:842.desc_zh:
在纯白底色上喷涂了铁锈色图案.

你的私人战吼

13:939.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a dark grey base and finished with green accents.

Going dark
13:939.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装采用了深灰色基底并配以绿色装饰。

走向黑暗

13:972.desc_en:
Phoenix faction logos have been spray painted over its white and red base.

They're bringing in the big guns
13:972.desc_zh:
凤凰组织标识采用了红色和白色的喷绘。

他们把大家伙带进来了

13:981.desc_en:
Its green base coat has been covered with scattered white drawings.

Each drawing tells a story, some more memorable than others
13:981.desc_zh:
这把武器使用绿色涂层，搭配上散乱的白色花纹。

每段旋律，都代表一种心情，每幅图画，都讲述一个故事，但愿人长久。

1314:1.desc_en: The official music kit of Counter-Strike 2.
1314:1.desc_zh: 反恐精英 官方音乐盒。

1314:10.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Sasha - 地球末夜
1314:10.desc_en: Immerse yourself in this cinematic soundtrack full of soaring strings, pulsating melodies and driving drums from the world renowned DJ / Producer Sasha
1314:10.desc_zh: 由世界著名的 DJ / 音乐制作人 Sasha 制作的大片级配乐，使自己沉浸于这高昂的弦乐、富有节奏感的旋律和醉人的鼓声之中吧。

1314:100.name_en: Music Kit | borne, Give It To Me
1314:100.desc_en: borne's gritty bass banger "Give It To Me" will have players ready to give it to their opponents in Counter-Strike, and beyond.
1314:100.desc_zh: borne这首粗粝质感的贝斯劲曲《给我》，让玩家无论在《反恐精英》游戏内外，都能狠狠的痛扁他们的对手。

1314:101.desc_en: Pirapus' high octane drum and bass anthem "EVERYNITE" evokes the feeling of being on the edge of greatness. True to its name, this one ensures you're locked in every night.
1314:101.desc_zh: Pirapus这首高能量的鼓打贝斯金曲《每夜》令人彷佛感到伟大触手可及。正如其名，这首歌定会让你每个夜晚都能沉浸其中。

1314:102.name_en: Music Kit | Repiet & Julia Kleijn, On And On
1314:102.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Repiet & Julia Kleijn, 循环不息
1314:102.desc_en: Be prepared for any challenge with Repiet and Julia Kleijn's infectious track "On And On." Through the highs and the lows, it's a tune that sets the tone to attack any obstacle.
1314:102.desc_zh: 跟随Repiet与Julia Kleijn这首极具感染力的单曲《循环不息》准备好迎接任何挑战吧，无论在高峰或是低谷，这首歌都能定下基调助你攻克一切障碍。

1314:103.desc_en: Break free with ShockOne's high energy drum and bass record "Voices." Primed for delivering in the clutch, this music kit features punchy bass lines that will carry you to many MVPs.
1314:103.desc_zh: 借助ShockOne的高能鼓打贝斯单曲《声流》挣脱束缚吧。这款音乐盒的特色贝斯线极具冲击力，将助你斩获无数MVP。

1314:11.desc_en: A lesson in aggression from Metal producer, Skog.
1314:11.desc_zh: 金属乐制作人 Skog 让你知道什么才叫侵略性。

1314:12.name_en: Music Kit | Midnight Riders, All I Want for Christmas
1314:12.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Midnight Riders - 圣诞之欲

1314:13.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Matt Lange - 同型节奏
1314:13.desc_en: Indulge your aural senses in a collection of cinematic, glitchy atmospheres and hard-hitting throbbing rhythms by electronic producer and innovator Matt Lange.
1314:13.desc_zh: 让耳朵沉浸在大片级毛刺音乐的氛围中，随着电子音乐制作人和革新者 Matt Lange 带来的刚健有力的节奏一起脉动吧。

1314:14.name_en: Music Kit | Mateo Messina, For No Mankind
1314:14.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Mateo Messina - 无人之境
1314:14.desc_en: Own your enemies. Pure intensity by Grammy winning composer, Mateo Messina.
1314:14.desc_zh: 征服你的敌人吧。格莱美大奖得主、作曲家 Mateo Messina 将带来摄人心魄的强音。

1314:15.name_en: Music Kit | Various Artists, Hotline Miami
1314:15.name_zh: 音乐盒 | 多名作曲家 - 迈阿密热线
1314:15.desc_en: A multitude of electronic artists deliver brutal beats in this exhilarating Music Pack from the iconic Hotline Miami.
1314:15.desc_zh: 众多电子音乐艺术家将在这个振奋人心的《迈阿密热线》形象音乐包中释放残暴的打击。

1314:16.name_en: Music Kit | Daniel Sadowski, Total Domination
1314:16.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Daniel Sadowski - 绝对统御
1314:16.desc_en: Composer Daniel Sadowski raises the bar with aggressive electronic beats, creative sound fx and an exhilerating, driving, futuristic vibe. "Warning: Will cause a rise in adrenaline!"
1314:16.desc_zh: 作曲家 Daniel Sadowski 将用他那强烈的打击感、创造性的声音效果和催人奋进、动力十足、充满未来主义的氛围让电子音乐登峰造极。“警告：肾上腺素飙升！”

1314:17.name_en: Music Kit | Damjan Mravunac, The Talos Principle
1314:17.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Damjan Mravunac - 塔罗斯的法则
1314:17.desc_en: Composer Damjan Mravunac blends energetic cinematic grooves with epic choirs in this music pack featuring music from Croteam's critically acclaimed title "The Talos Principle".
1314:17.desc_zh: 作曲家 Damjan Mravunac 将富有张力的大片级配乐与恢弘的唱诗班歌声融合于这一音乐包中，精选了由 Croteam 制作的广受好评的游戏作品《塔罗斯的法则》中的音乐。

1314:18.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Proxy - 万夫莫敌包
1314:18.desc_en: Russian Heavy Electronica Artist PROXY brings his own Unique heavy artillery to Counter Strike. Hybrid audio Weaponry fused with the finest studio technology makes this pack unique.
1314:18.desc_zh: 俄罗斯重型电子乐作曲家 PROXY 为《反恐精英》带来了他自己独特的重音炮。混音武器与最棒的录音棚技术使这个音乐专辑变得独一无二。

1314:19.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Ki:Theory - 莫洛托夫烈火
1314:19.desc_en: Recording artist and DOTA TI4 performer, Ki:Theory drops BOMBS with this searing set of razor edge dark electronic rock.
1314:19.desc_zh: 身为唱片艺术家和 DOTA TI4 的音乐表演者，Ki:Theory 融刀锋的炙热和黑暗的电子摇滚乐为一体，投下了“重磅炸弹”。

1314:20.name_en: Music Kit | Troels Folmann, Uber Blasto Phone
1314:20.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Troels Folmann - 超爆话筒
1314:20.desc_en: Triumphant Blastophones combine with contemporary Uberpulse in this explosive collection by ultra award winning composer Troels Folmann.
1314:20.desc_zh: 诉说胜利的超爆话筒与现代超级脉冲相结合，这就是屡获殊荣的作曲家 Troels Folmann 带来的劲爆专辑。

1314:21.name_en: Music Kit | Kelly Bailey, Hazardous Environments
1314:21.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Kelly Bailey - 有害物质环境
1314:21.desc_en: Kelly Bailey, composer of Valve's Half-Life series, creates an arsenal of apocalyptic new music inspired by the darker side of the Half-Life universe.
1314:21.desc_zh: Kelly Bailey，Valve《半条命》系列的作曲家，受《半条命》游戏世界的阴暗面启发，创作出一套全新的核灾变式音乐。

1314:22.desc_en: Metal composer and producer Jocke Skog returns with an all new, hard hitting metal kit, turning the rest of the CS:GO Music Kits into something cute, warm and fuzzy. Now go become MVP so everyone can hear your awesomeness!
1314:22.desc_zh: 金属乐作曲家和制作人 Jocke Skog 携着全新的强力金属音乐盒回来了，他让CS:GO余下的音乐盒变得可爱、温暖人心和模糊。现在赶紧成为 MVP，让所有人都能听到您那令人敬畏的声音吧！

1314:23.name_en: Music Kit | Daniel Sadowski, The 8-Bit Kit
1314:23.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Daniel Sadowski - 8 位音乐盒
1314:23.desc_en: Daniel Sadowski creates the first ever 8-bit Music Kit for Counter-Strike complete with authentic 8-bit sounds.
1314:23.desc_zh: Daniel Sadowski 首次用纯正的 8 位音效为 反恐精英 创作出了 8 位音乐盒。

1314:24.name_zh: 音乐盒 | AWOLNATION - 就是我
1314:24.desc_en: AWOLNATION Alternative Rocker AWOLNATION brings you a music kit for the ages. This kit is jam-packed with an eclectic selection of tunes and includes cuts from singles 'I Am' and multi-platinum hit 'Sail'.
1314:24.desc_zh: AWOLNATION 另类摇滚乐手 AWOLNATION 为您带来划时代的音乐盒。这个音乐盒充满着不同类型的音调，包括来自单曲“就是我”和多白金摇滚乐“启航”的剪辑。

1314:25.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Mord Fustang - 永恒之钻
1314:25.desc_en: Diamonds. They are forever. Dive into the arpeggiotron of Mord Fustang with this fresh set of grooves and atmospheres.
1314:25.desc_zh: 钻石。它们是永恒的。随着这部充满清新旋律和气氛的专辑深入 Mord Fustang 的电子琶音吧。

1314:26.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Michael Bross - 大举入侵！
1314:26.desc_en: Michael Bross conjures epic / cinematic techno-grunge to make you feel like a true badass in battle.
1314:26.desc_zh: Michael Bross 奏响的史诗/电影级技术邋遢摇滚会让你感觉自己成为了战斗中真正的王者。

1314:27.name_en: Music Kit | Ian Hultquist, Lion's Mouth
1314:27.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Ian Hultquist - 雄狮之口
1314:27.desc_en: Mixing pulsating strings and synths with pounding war drums, prepare yourself for battle with this thunderous soundtrack from composer Ian Hultquist.
1314:27.desc_zh: 以敲打战鼓的方式将脉动的音符与合成乐相结合，准备好与作曲家 Ian Hultquist 创作的这部雷鸣般的配乐一起战斗吧。

1314:28.name_en: Music Kit | New Beat Fund, Sponge Fingerz
1314:28.name_zh: 音乐盒 | New Beat Fund - 海绵手指
1314:28.desc_en: Sunny surf rock with elements of hip-hop, punk and garage pop. Keep it real and get headshots.
1314:28.desc_zh: 阳光的冲浪摇滚搭配着嘻哈乐、朋克风和车库流行乐。相信自己，把敌人的脑袋统统爆掉。

1314:29.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Beartooth - 令人发指
1314:29.desc_en: Beartooth brings an agressive back-to-basics hardcore stomp that gets crowds moving and breaking stuff. A perfect soundtrack for your no-scope scout frags. Rock 'till you're dead.
1314:29.desc_zh: Beartooth 带来了充满侵略性的本格硬核践踏式音乐，能让观众变得狂躁不安。非常适合你们这群用鸟狙不开镜的狙击狂魔。用力摇滚，至死方休。

1314:3.name_en: Music Kit | Daniel Sadowski, Crimson Assault
1314:3.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Daniel Sadowski - 深红突击
1314:3.desc_en: Video Game Composer Daniel Sadowski delivers Edgy Action mixed with CRAZY FAT beats in this pulsating, exhilarating Music Pack.
1314:3.desc_zh: 在这个充满节奏感且令人振奋的音乐包中，电子游戏作曲家 Daniel Sadowski 将结合极度疯狂的打击感，带来激情四射的演奏。

1314:30.name_en: Music Kit | Lennie Moore, Java Havana Funkaloo
1314:30.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Lennie Moore - 爪哇哈瓦那放克乐
1314:30.desc_en: Game Composer Lennie Moore serves an aromatic, spicy blend of Jazzy Funk. Delicious when served cold, like the corpses of your enemies after you're done with them.
1314:30.desc_zh: 游戏作曲家 Lennie Moore 为您献上一部芬芳与辛辣相混合的爵士放克乐。冷冻时风味最佳，就和那些被您干掉的敌人的尸体一样。

1314:31.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Darude - CSGO 精彩时刻
1314:31.desc_en: Yield freely in the soundscapes of Finnish producer Darude's familiar musical flavours and tones. Enriching yourself with access to a heavy fusion of progressive overtones and scores of tingling melodic structure from the sounds banks of one of dance music's most renowned pioneers.
1314:31.desc_zh: 向芬兰制作人 Darude 创作的音景中熟悉的音乐旋律和音调献上膝盖。由最负盛名的先驱创作，让自己畅游在渐进式的泛音和音库中激动人心的旋律结构的重度结合之中吧。

1314:32.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Beartooth - 咄咄逼人
1314:32.desc_en: Beartooth is back for round two. This new music kit hits harder and is even more aggressive. We've also made the MVP anthem extra heavy so your opponents feel really bad after they've lost to you.
1314:32.desc_zh: Beartooth 再次回归，展开了第二轮音乐攻势。这个新的音乐盒节奏更加强劲，并且比以往都要咄咄逼人。我们也让 MVP 凯歌变得异常“沉重”，这样你的对手就会在被你击败后感到糟糕透顶。

1314:33.name_en: Music Kit | Blitz Kids, The Good Youth
1314:33.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Blitz Kids - 有为青年
1314:33.desc_en: British Pop/Punk band Blitz Kids brings you the perfect music kit for rushing B while thinking about those night drives you had with your friends in High School. This kit is for going fast and feeling young.
1314:33.desc_zh: 英国流行乐/朋克乐队 Blitz Kids 为你带来一边突击 B 区，一边思考你高中时与好友深夜飙车美好时光的完美音乐盒。这个音乐盒节奏明快，充满年轻人的活力。

1314:34.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Hundredth - 冲破藩篱
1314:34.desc_en: Hundredth is bringing heavy to the world with their unique take on melodic hardcore. Break free or return to Dust with this perfect soundtrack for fragging the unworthy.
1314:34.desc_zh: Hundredth 用他们对旋律硬核的独到见解将重音乐带到了这个世界。听着这完美的配乐，冲破藩篱，回到炙热沙城，粉碎那些恶徒吧。

1314:35.name_en: Music Kit | Neck Deep, Life's Not Out To Get You
1314:35.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Neck Deep - 人生何处不青山
1314:35.desc_en: Sometimes you just need some Pop Punk to get you through the day. Whether it is dealing with campers or losing a massive kill streak, Neck Deep is here to prove that Life's Not Out To Get You, but the other team still is.
1314:35.desc_zh: 有时候，你真的只需要听些流行朋克乐来帮你度过一整天。无论是在对付蹲坑汉还是陷入疯狂的大杀特杀，Neck Deep 都将在此为你带来“人生何处不青山”，不过另外一支队伍可留不得青山了。

1314:36.desc_en: Roam delivers fast, straight-forward Pop Punk that gets crowd and players alike moving. Prove you have a Backbone with this perfect soundtrack for rushing in and obliterating the other team before they even realize they're deadweight.
1314:36.desc_zh: Roam 为你带来快节拍且直截了当的流行朋克乐，好让观众和玩家都动起来。 搭配这完美的配乐，在另一支队伍还没反应到自己有多渣前突击并歼灭他们，证明你的决心吧。

1314:37.desc_en: Heavier, rowdier, and louder than ever, Twin Atlantic comes to CS:GO ready to help you melt the faces with the firepower of Scottish rock.
1314:37.desc_zh: 比以往都要沉重、喧闹和响亮，Twin Atlantic 降临到CS:GO，准备好用苏格兰摇滚的火力来助你对敌人造成心灵震爆。

1314:38.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Skog - III-竞技场
1314:38.desc_en: Skog is back with a third crushing metal kit. This time with an electro-organic twist to the music, combining massive guitar riffs with equally massive drops, loop elements and drones.
1314:38.desc_zh: Skog 带着第三部碾压金属音乐盒回来了。这一次他们将为音乐带来有机电的转变，结合大量的吉他乐段，配以等量巨大的摔落、循环元素和低鸣。

1314:39.desc_en: The Verkkars rise through the Finnish charts with a heart-pounding tribute to ENCE. Can it really be so EZ?
1314:39.desc_zh: The Verkkars 凭借这首向 ENCE 致敬的动人心弦之曲在芬兰排行榜上崭露头角。要不要这么 EZ ？

1314:4.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Noisia - 尖峰时刻
1314:4.desc_en: Dutch Electronic Trio Noisia brings a tough, cinematic feel with a unique blend of tradition and progression.
1314:4.desc_zh: 荷兰电子音乐家 Trio Noisia 独特地融合了传统与创新，将带来如同欣赏硬派电影大片的感觉。

1314:40.name_en: Music Kit | Halo, The Master Chief Collection
1314:40.name_zh: 音乐盒 | 《光环：士官长合集》
1314:40.desc_en: Give your Counter Strike auditory experience a legendary makeover with the Master Chief Collection Music Pack, featuring iconic musical moments from the Halo universe. © 2019 343 Industries. All rights reserved. Used with permission from 343 Industries. Halo: The Master Chief Collection and the Halo logo are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.
1314:40.desc_zh: 士官长合集音乐盒包含来自《光环》宇宙的标志性音乐时刻，会使你在反恐精英游戏中的听觉体验获得一个传奇般的改变。© 2019 343 Industries.所有权利保留。由© 2019 343 Industries.授权。《光环：士官长合集》与《光环》图标为微软集团的注册商标。

1314:41.desc_en: Scarlxrd blends heavy trap beats with a flow and delivery that creates his own unique subgenre. With this exciting blend his live shows capture the attention of everyone in the crowd.
1314:41.desc_zh: Scarlxrd 将重金属节拍与创造出他独有流派的律动和表演风格结合。通过这种令人激动的融合，他的现场表演吸引了所有人的注意。

1314:42.name_zh: 音乐盒 | 《半衰期：爱莉克斯》，反叛者
1314:42.desc_en: This music kit commemorates Half-Life: Alyx, Valve's VR return to the Half-Life series. You are humanity's only chance for survival, and your immersive environmental interactions continue in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.
1314:42.desc_zh: 这是纪念《半衰期：爱莉克斯》的音乐盒，代表了Valve利用虚拟现实技术让《半衰期》系列得以回归。你是人类生存的唯一机会, 并且你的沉浸式环境互动会在《反恐精英：全球攻势》中得以延续。

1314:43.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Austin Wintory - 巴克拉姆
1314:43.desc_en: Austin Wintory mixes Celtic fantasy with sizzling electronics and a generous helping of Peter Hollens' vocals in this genre-bending Music Kit.
1314:43.desc_zh: Austin Wintory将凯尔特幻想风的音乐与低沉的电子音混合在一起，并通过Peter Hollens的人声进行调和，形成了这一类型糅合的音乐盒。

1314:44.name_en: Music Kit | Dren, Gunman Taco Truck
1314:44.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Dren - 枪炮卷饼卡车
1314:44.desc_en: The apocalyptic mariachi soundtrack from the indie game hit, Gunman Taco Truck, comes to CS:GO with intense Mexican flavored tunes like Pollo Diablo and Persecución de Helltain!
1314:44.desc_zh: 来自独立游戏大作《枪手的卷饼卡车》中的末日流浪乐队，为CS:GO带来了具有浓烈的墨西哥风味的原声音乐，例如《魔鬼鸡》和《地狱追逐》！

1314:45.name_en: Music Kit | Daniel Sadowski, Eye of the Dragon
1314:45.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Daniel Sadowski - 巨龙之眼
1314:45.desc_en: From the composer who brought you "Total Domination", "The 8-Bit Kit" and "Crimson Assault", comes "Eye Of The Dragon". Music composer Daniel Sadowski mixes Ninjas + Guns + Hip-Hop + Techno to create an action-packed Music Kit. Ninjas are known for their fast and precise attacks, yet they can be invisible to their enemy.
1314:45.desc_zh: 曾创作出《绝对统御》、《8 位音乐盒》和《深红突击》的作曲家带来的全新作品——《巨龙之眼》。作曲家Daniel Sadowski融合了忍者，枪声，嘻哈和科技感，从而创造出了这个动感十足的音乐盒。 忍者们以快速精确的攻击而闻名，但是敌人根本看不见他们。

1314:46.name_en: Music Kit | Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield, M.U.D.D. FORCE
1314:46.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Tree Adams 和 Ben Bromfield - M.U.D.D. 军团
1314:46.desc_en: Alchemists of a powerful chaos that is M.U.D.D. FORCE - composers Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield weld epic battle motifs and grinding synths into a Maelstrom of full throttle destruction.
1314:46.desc_zh: M.U.D.D. 军团是一群拥有着强大的混沌之力的炼金术士——作曲家Tree Adams和Ben Bromfield将史诗级的战斗画面和无休止的电子合成音焊入了一场马力全开的破坏漩涡之中。

1314:47.name_en: Music Kit | Tim Huling, Neo Noir
1314:47.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Tim Huling - 新黑色电影
1314:47.desc_en: Composer Tim Huling delivers classic film-noir style tracks blended with contemporary grooves and beats.
1314:47.desc_zh: 作曲家Tim Huling提供了经典的黑色电影风格的曲目，其中又融合了现代的节奏和节拍。

1314:48.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Sam Marshall - 大胆尝试
1314:48.desc_en: Inspired by the funky video game music of the early 90s, composer Sam Marshall cooks up some classic game nostalgia with a spicy modern sauce.
1314:48.desc_zh: 作曲家Sam Marshall受到90年代初期时髦的电子游戏音乐的启发，以刺激的现代调料烹饪出一些经典的游戏怀旧情调。

1314:49.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Matt Levine - 漂泊者
1314:49.desc_en: Composer Matt Levine delivers raw swagger in this gritty homage to the Spaghetti Western. It has never felt better to say, "go ahead, make my day..."
1314:49.desc_zh: 作曲家Matt Levine在这首曲子中向意大利西部片致以不加掩饰的敬意。“有种你就放马过来，看我怎么收拾你...”没有比说出这话更爽的了。

1314:5.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Robert Allaire - 叛乱
1314:5.desc_en: Music to crush your enemies see them driven before you from award winning composer Robert Allaire.
1314:5.desc_zh: 由屡获殊荣的作曲家 Robert Allaire 创作，让音乐碾碎你的敌人，看着他们先你一步而去吧。

1314:50.name_en: Music Kit | Amon Tobin, All for Dust
1314:50.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Amon Tobin - 尘归尘
1314:50.desc_en: Legendary producer Amon Tobin lends his unique aesthetic to CS:GO. This time through tube amplifiers.
1314:50.desc_zh: 传奇制作人 Amon Tobin 这次把他对音乐的独到理解融入到《反恐精英：全球攻势》中，借助电子管放大器放送音乐。

1314:51.name_en: Music Kit | Darren Korb, Hades Music Kit
1314:51.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Darren Korb，黑帝斯音乐盒
1314:51.desc_en: Sure, you might miss a shot from time to time, but what never misses is this blood-pumping Music Kit straight from the Underworld of Hades, Supergiant's rogue-like dungeon crawler.
1314:51.desc_zh: 在游戏里，你可能会时不时错失良机，但最好不要错过这款令人热血沸腾的音乐盒，它来自于Supergiant的Rogue-like游戏《黑帝斯》。

1314:52.name_en: Music Kit | Neck Deep, The Lowlife Pack
1314:52.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Neck Deep - 躺平青年
1314:52.desc_en: Prove you are not a normie (and better than everyone else on the map) with Neck Deep's new music kit, which includes songs from the band's album All Distortions Are Intentional.
1314:52.desc_zh: 用Neck Deep的全新音乐盒来证明，你不是一个趋于平凡的人（要做到比地图上的其他人更好），其中包括乐队专辑《All Distortions Are Intentional》中的歌曲。

1314:53.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Scarlxrd - 电锯·追命
1314:53.desc_en: CHAIN$AW BRINGS SCARLXRD AT HIS UNPRECENDENTED BEST WITH A RAW FLOW AND A HEAVY TRACK TO MATCH.
1314:53.desc_zh: 在《电锯·追命》中，将展现SCARLXRD其无与伦比的最佳状态，并带来一种原始的个人风格以及沉重的节奏。

1314:54.name_en: Music Kit | Austin Wintory, Mocha Petal
1314:54.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Austin Wintory - 咖啡拉花
1314:54.desc_en: Austin Wintory answers the question humanity has asked for ages: what happens if you merge beer garden accordion polka music with grungy heavy metal?
1314:54.desc_zh: Austin Wintory 回答了人类长久以来的问题：如果你把啤酒花园的手风琴波尔卡音乐和邋遢的重金属音乐混合在一起会发生什么？

1314:55.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Chipzel - 黄色魔法
1314:55.desc_en: Video game composer and chiptune legend Chipzel brings a glitchy Speak & Spell inspired mashup of hybrid styles packed with fun, funk and flavour.
1314:55.desc_zh: 电子游戏作曲家，合成电子乐传奇人物 Chipzel 带来了灵感来自“言出法随”的混合格调音乐，充满了乐趣、放克和风味。

1314:56.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Freaky DNA - 征服
1314:56.desc_en: Opera. 8-bit sounds. Analogue synths. What's not to love? Chiptune specialist Freaky DNA and soprano Leanne Koch team up for some heavy beats and good times!
1314:56.desc_zh: 歌剧。8 位芯片音乐。模拟合成器。有什么理由不爱呢？合成电子乐专家 Freaky DNA 与女高音 Leanne Koch 精诚合作，通过强有力的节拍让听众度过美好时光！

1314:57.name_en: Music Kit | Jesse Harlin, Astro Bellum
1314:57.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Jesse Harlin - 战火星空
1314:57.desc_en: Composer Jesse Harlin delivers bombastic space opera drama inspired by classic sci-fi of the 70s, 80s, and beyond.
1314:57.desc_zh: 作曲家 Jesse Harlin 灵感来自于70年代、80年代及以后的经典科幻作品，呈现了一部爆炸式的太空歌剧。

1314:58.name_en: Music Kit | Laura Shigihara: Work Hard, Play Hard
1314:58.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Laura Shigihara - 好好干，好好活
1314:58.desc_en: Video game composer and developer Laura Shigihara will help you tell everyone loudly and proudly that you're the MVP. Have fun with this unique blend of 90s dance, retro video game synth, and just a hint of Plants vs. Zombies.
1314:58.desc_zh: 电子游戏作曲家兼开发者 Laura Shigihara 将帮助你大声而自豪地告诉大家，你就是 MVP。这首音乐中融合了独特的90年代舞曲，复古电子游戏合成器以及《植物大战僵尸》彩蛋，希望你能从中获得乐趣。

1314:59.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Sarah Schachner - 蜂鸟
1314:59.desc_en: Brought to you by Sarah Schachner, a dystopian goth choir of self-aware, Scandinavian robots decide that humanity must be eliminated.
1314:59.desc_zh: 具有自知之明的反乌托邦式哥特摇滚乐团音乐，他们想要表达斯堪的纳维亚的机器人裁定，人类必须被消灭。由 Sarah Schachner 为你倾情呈现。

1314:6.desc_en: From the composer of two of the world's biggest war games, comes a sonic loadout that will bring your enemies to Hell's Gate!!
1314:6.desc_zh: 由世界上最大的两款战争游戏的作曲家倾情演绎，用音速武装全身，把你的敌人送上地狱之路吧！！

1314:60.name_zh: 音乐盒 | bbno$ - 你急了！
1314:60.desc_en: bbno$ formulates 'the' toxic gamer anthem, u mad! Are u mad? LOL get good scrub. Research shows if you play with this Music Kit equipped you'll immediately go from Silver to Global.
1314:60.desc_zh: bbno$专门为重度玩家倾情打造的曲子“你急了！”所以，你是急了吗？哈哈，来洗洗耳朵吧！调查显示，如果配备了这款音乐盒体验游戏，你将有机会立马从白银直升全球精英哦！

1314:61.name_en: Music Kit | The Verkkars & n0thing, Flashbang Dance
1314:61.name_zh: 音乐盒 | The Verkkars & n0thing - 闪光舞
1314:61.desc_en: From sunny California to frigid Lapland, Counter-Strike legend n0thing and The Verkkars combine powers to create the smash hit, Flashbang Dance! 3, 2, 1 you’re blind!
1314:61.desc_zh: 从阳光四射的加州到冰冷严寒的拉普兰，由反恐精英传奇选手 n0thing 联合 The Verkkars 共同打造，带来的畅销单曲《闪光舞》！倒数321，亮瞎你的眼！

1314:62.name_en: Music Kit | 3kliksphilip, Heading for the Source
1314:62.desc_en: On a quest to go pro, or unintentionally going low? Let this kit’s 80’s synths and dreamy melodies take you back. Back, back, back... to the good old days.
1314:62.desc_zh: 职业路径向上探索，或不经意间状态低迷？通过这款音乐盒把你带回1980年代，在那如梦似幻般的旋律中，去追忆过往的美好时光吧。

1314:63.name_en: Music Kit | Humanity's Last Breath, Void
1314:63.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Humanity's Last Breath - 虚空
1314:63.desc_en: Swedish Band Humanity's Last Breath drops in heavy with their Void Music Kit. Pounding drums, colossal riffs and an atmosphere to send shivers up your spine.
1314:63.desc_zh: 这款“虚空”音乐盒由瑞典乐队Humanity's Last Breath打造，伴随着猛烈的鼓点，通过大量的重金属乐段，呈现一种不寒而栗的气氛。

1314:64.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Juelz - 神枪手
1314:64.desc_en: Neo trap synths, gritty 808s, an epic piano riff, and a plethora of gunfire sound effects. The OG trap anthem "Shooters" by Juelz makes for a truly elite Music Kit. Suitable for MVPs only.
1314:64.desc_zh: 在这首新嘻哈音乐中，您能听到粗犷沉重的808鼓，史诗般的钢琴乐段以及大量的枪声音效。由Juelz创作的这款元老级嘻哈凯歌“神枪手”，使这个音乐盒集如虎添翼。仅适用于MVP选手。

1314:65.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Knock2 - 冲击星*
1314:65.desc_en: dashstar*, the iconic bass house anthem from Knock2, provides non-stop energy that captures the young San Diego native’s mantra, "no limit".
1314:65.desc_zh: 来自Knock2的“冲击星*”是一首标志性的贝斯浩室凯歌，可为您提供源源不断的能量。配乐中引用了圣地亚哥年轻一代的口头禅“海阔凭鱼跃”。

1314:66.name_en: Music Kit | Meechy Darko, Gothic Luxury
1314:66.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Meechy Darko - 哥特浮华
1314:66.desc_en: Grab a Glock and equip this music kit to be transported to the center of New York's underground hip-hop scene.
1314:66.desc_zh: 拿上一把格洛克手枪，并装备这款音乐盒，就可被传送到纽约地下嘻哈圈的中心。

1314:67.name_en: Music Kit | Sullivan King, Lock Me Up
1314:67.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Sullivan King - 困兽
1314:67.desc_en: Love the chase? Love the hunt? Hard rock, metal, and dubstep collide in Sullivan King's soundtrack for becoming unstoppable.
1314:67.desc_zh: 喜欢追逐吗？喜欢狩猎吗？在Sullivan King的这首配乐中，硬摇滚、金属乐和回响贝斯之间擦出火花，形成了一股不可阻挡之势。

1314:68.name_en: Music Kit | Perfect World, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face)
1314:68.name_zh: 音乐盒 | 完美世界 - 花脸
1314:68.desc_en: Celebrate the 5th anniversary of CS:GO's release in China with a one of a kind music kit, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face). This kit combines folk Qinqiang opera (the earliest Chinese style Rock 'n' Roll) and modern Rock 'n' Roll. Whether you are engulfed in smoke or blinded by a flashbang, don't get lost!
1314:68.desc_zh: 为了庆祝CS:GO国服五周年纪念日，上线了一款别具一格的音乐盒，名为“花脸”。这款音乐盒以中国最古老戏曲之一的“秦腔”融合了现代摇滚。无论您是被烟雾弹环绕还是被闪光弹致盲，都不要迷失方向！

1314:69.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Denzel Curry - 终极
1314:69.desc_en: Denzel brings his signature energy to CS:GO as he traverses trap, jazz, and drum and bass beats. This kit features Denzel's hits "Walkin", "ULTIMATE", and more, so break out the nickel-plated chrome Berettas and crank up the intensity with the ULTIMATE music kit.
1314:69.desc_zh: Denzel 将他独具特色的街头嘻哈、爵士和鼓打贝斯的能量带到了 CS:GO 中。这个音乐盒包含 Denzel 的歌曲《Walkin》、《ULTIMATE》以及更多内容。那么来《终极》音乐盒聆听：“break out the nickel-plated chrome Berettas”，燥起来吧！

1314:7.name_en: Music Kit | Feed Me, High Noon
1314:7.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Feed Me - 如日中天
1314:7.desc_en: Renowned elecronic musician Feed Me, brings a western corral showdown into a modern electronic space.
1314:7.desc_zh: 大名鼎鼎的电音制作人 Feed Me 倾情呈现，让西部牛仔对决见识见识现代电子空间吧。

1314:70.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Valve，反恐精英：全球攻势
1314:70.desc_en: The default CS:GO music kit, introduced with the launch of CS:GO in 2012.
1314:70.desc_zh: 默认的《反恐精英：全球攻势》音乐盒，随 2012 年《反恐精英：全球攻势》发布而推出。

1314:71.name_en: Music Kit | DRYDEN, Feel The Power
1314:71.name_zh: 音乐盒 | DRYDEN - 触摸能量
1314:71.desc_en: What else needs to be said? Feel The Power. Lock in with this high-energy electro Music Kit from DRYDEN.
1314:71.desc_zh: 闭嘴，触摸能量！用DRYDEN的这款高能电子音乐盒锁定氛围。

1314:72.name_zh: 音乐盒 | ISOxo - 非人类
1314:72.desc_en: Made especially for those games when you feel... different. Haunt your enemies round after round with the "inhuman" Music Kit from ISOxo.
1314:72.desc_zh: 专为那些让你感觉... 与众不同的游戏制作。使用来自ISOxo的“非人类”音乐盒，将敌人困囿于你一轮又一轮的胜利号角中。

1314:73.name_en: Music Kit | KILL SCRIPT, All Night
1314:73.name_zh: 音乐盒 | KILL SCRIPT - 通宵达旦
1314:73.desc_en: Are you a lover or a fighter? Perhaps both? Let the entire lobby know with the "All Night" Music Kit from KILL SCRIPT.
1314:73.desc_zh: 你是博爱之人还是好斗之徒？或者两者都是？让整个大厅都响起来自KILL SCRIPT的“通宵达旦”音乐盒吧。

1314:74.name_en: Music Kit | Knock2, Make U SWEAT!
1314:74.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Knock2 - 燥起来！
1314:74.desc_en: For players who treat every game like it's a Major Grand Final, even when there's only a few hundred CSR on the line. Bring the energy and the wins with Knock2's second Music Kit, "Make U SWEAT!".
1314:74.desc_zh: 对于将每场比赛都当做Major决赛来打的玩家，即使CS综合得分只有几百也会全力以赴。Knock2的第二个音乐盒“燥起来！”将为你带来能量和胜利。

1314:75.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Rad Cat - 理由
1314:75.desc_en: Sometimes defusing the bomb is enough to be the round MVP. Celebrate every moment—big or small—with the "Reason" Music Kit from Rad Cat.
1314:75.desc_zh: 有时候拆除炸弹就足以成为回合MVP。使用Rad Cat的音乐盒“理由”庆祝每一个时刻，无论大小。

1314:76.name_en: Music Kit | TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack, Under Bright Lights
1314:76.name_zh: 音乐盒 | TWERL 和 Ekko & Sidetrack - 万众瞩目
1314:76.desc_en: There's no better time to come alive than when in the spotlight. Let the drum and bass anthem "Under Bright Lights" by TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack carry you and your team to new heights.
1314:76.desc_zh: 聚光灯就位，动起来。让TWERL和Ekko & Sidetrack的电音舞曲“万众瞩目”带领你和你的队伍冲向新高度。

1314:78.name_en: Music Kit | Austin Wintory, The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia
1314:78.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Austin Wintory，恶魔舞厅
1314:78.desc_en: Austin Wintory makes a deal with Satan, smashing together devilish fiddle music with full-on EDM club vibes.
1314:78.desc_zh: Austin Wintory 和撒旦做了笔交易，将恶魔般的小提琴音乐与火力全开的电子舞曲碰撞融合在一起。

1314:79.name_en: Music Kit | Ben Bromfield, Rabbit Hole
1314:79.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Ben Bromfield，兔子洞
1314:79.desc_en: You've been double-crossed! Experience this high-stakes, broodingly tense, jazz-inspired soundtrack from film & TV composer Ben Bromfield as you uncover just how deep this rabbit hole goes...
1314:79.desc_zh: 你被耍了！体验惊险刺激、灵感来自爵士音乐的配乐，由电影和电视作曲家Ben Bromfield创作，兔子洞到底有多深，等你来揭晓...

1314:8.name_en: Music Kit | Dren, Death's Head Demolition
1314:8.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Dren - 骷髅爆破
1314:8.desc_en: From game music composer Dren, this cinematic, superhero-metal inspired music pack puts the 'ill' into KILL!
1314:8.desc_zh: 由游戏音乐作曲家 Dren 制作，这个受超级英雄金属乐启发的大片级音乐包将让你从菜鸟变成大杀特杀的狂魔！

1314:80.name_en: Music Kit | Daniel Sadowski, Dead Shot
1314:80.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Daniel Sadowski，致命一击
1314:80.desc_en: Daniel Sadowski invites players to enter the world of "Dead Shot", a hybrid blend of action, hip-hop, orchestral, electronic, retro, emotion, and sound design. Avoid the Head Rot!
1314:80.desc_zh: Daniel Sadowski 邀请玩家进入《致命一击》的世界，这是一首融合动作、嘻哈、管弦乐、电子、复古、情绪和音效设计的大杂烩。别听上头了！

1314:81.name_en: Music Kit | Dren McDonald, Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!
1314:81.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Dren McDonald，咖啡！加非！磕肥！
1314:81.desc_en: Caffeine is your friend. It's everybody's friend, except for your enemy! "Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!" is BalkanBalkanBalkan! street party brass music from Dren Mcdonald ("Gunman Taco Truck" and "Death’s Head Demolition") recorded live in Balkancisco!
1314:81.desc_zh: 除了你的敌人之外，咖啡因可以是任何人的朋友，当然也包括你！《咖啡！加非！磕肥！》是《枪炮卷饼卡车》和《骷髅爆破》的作者Dren Mcdonald创作的巴尔干街头派对铜管音乐，这可是在旧金山湾区巴尔干西斯科现场录制的！

1314:82.desc_en: Enter the dangerous world of espionage with the "Agency" music kit from composer Matt Levine.
1314:82.desc_zh: 跟随作曲家Matt Levine，进入危险的间谍世界，体验《特工》音乐盒的魅力。

1314:83.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Sam Marshall，危在旦夕
1314:83.desc_en: "Clutch", the unsanctioned sequel to "Bodacious", is a cyber-funk, fever dream abomination reanimated by Sam Marshall through alchemy and arcane ritual.
1314:83.desc_zh: 作为《大胆尝试》的非正式续作，赛博放克风格的《危在旦夕》是Sam Marshall通过炼金术和神秘仪式复活的迷幻怪胎。

1314:84.name_en: Music Kit | Tim Huling, Devil's Paintbrush
1314:84.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Tim Huling，恶魔油漆刷
1314:84.desc_en: Get your adrenaline up with "Devil's Paintbrush" from Tim Huling, a high-energy groove-metal experience.
1314:84.desc_zh: 从Tim Huling的《恶魔油漆刷》中感受肾上腺素的冲击，一次充满能量的蛊戮金属体验。

1314:85.name_en: Music Kit | Tree Adams, Seventh Moon
1314:85.desc_en: Here on "Seventh Moon", Tree Adams rolls up a greasy mix of intergalactic funk with a driving battle score.
1314:85.desc_zh: 在《柒月》中，Tree Adams丝滑地将星际放克和激烈的战斗配乐融合在一起，打造出独特的音乐体验。

1314:86.name_en: Music Kit | Perfect World, Ay Hey
1314:86.name_zh: 音乐盒 | 完美世界，诶嘿
1314:86.desc_en: Merging traditional Chinese folk and electronic music, "Ay Hey" offers vivid storytelling and energetic beats to connect players of different ages and backgrounds. With its lively rhythm matching players' enthusiasm for the game, "Ay Hey" vividly captures various humorous and playful battle scenes.
1314:86.desc_zh: 将壮族非遗民歌与电子乐进行融合创作，演绎出战斗中各种诙谐戏谑的场景氛围。民歌和电子乐的交融，使这首歌既有朴素的叙事性，又有充满活力的节奏感，触动和连接不同年龄和地域的玩家。

1314:87.name_en: Music Kit | Adam Beyer, Red Room
1314:87.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Adam Beyer，猩红密室
1314:87.desc_en: Swedish techno legend Adam Beyer brings you this dreamy belter of a music kit to help paint your enemies red.
1314:87.desc_zh: 瑞典电子传奇Adam Beyer带来这套迷幻而暴烈的音乐盒，助你血染敌阵。

1314:88.desc_en: MESSAGE FROM THE CLERGY—Papa V Perpetua has descended on Counter-Strike in a glorious heavy metal spectacle. Escape the travails of daily life as you spray and pray to the Unholy See.
1314:88.desc_zh: 【来自神职人员的讯息】“第五任永久教皇”已经在华丽重金属盛宴中降临CS。愿你能在扫射与向邪恶圣座的祈祷中，逃离世俗纷扰。

1314:89.desc_en: Experience HEALTH in Counter-Strike. Take up arms and enjoy the brutal and punishing industrial metal sound of RAT WARS.
1314:89.desc_zh: 在CS中体验HEALTH的残酷工业金属之声。拿起武器，迎接《鼠役》的暴虐音浪。

1314:9.name_en: Music Kit | Austin Wintory, Desert Fire
1314:9.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Austin Wintory - 沙漠之焰
1314:9.desc_en: Grammy nominated game composer Austin Wintory asks, why bother hunting your enemies when you can lure them in with a deadly, admittedly insane, tango?
1314:9.desc_zh: 格莱美提名的游戏作曲家 Austin Wintory 大感不解地问道：“当你可以用致命而又无比疯狂的探戈舞曲蛊惑你的敌人时，你何必还要那么急着去猎杀他们呢？”

1314:90.name_en: Music Kit | James and the Cold Gun, Chewing Glass
1314:90.name_zh: 音乐盒 | James and the Cold Gun，嚼玻璃
1314:90.desc_en: Welsh rock duo James and the Cold Gun unleash pure, unfiltered energy, blending classic punk attitude with modern alt-rock fire to create a blistering music kit.
1314:90.desc_zh: 威尔士摇滚双人组James and the Cold Gun释放纯粹能量，混合经典朋克态度与现代另类摇滚烈火，打造出这套爆裂音乐盒。

1314:91.name_en: Music Kit | Jonathan Young, Starship Velociraptor
1314:91.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Jonathan Young，星际战机速龙号
1314:91.desc_en: Space-Pirate Power Metal is what your game is missing. Take a ride on the Starship Velociraptor and let the sounds of Jonathan Young's anime and video game inspired album bring your matches to another level.
1314:91.desc_zh: 你的游戏缺的正是"太空海盗力量金属"。登上星际战机速龙号，让Jonathan Young受动漫和游戏启发的专辑将比赛提升至新维度。

1314:92.desc_en: Need Floorspace? This massive music kit from Juelz’s debut album contains neo-rave synths, gritty bass lines, and hard hitting trap drums. Floorspace has been reimagined for Counter-Strike 2, and the MVP anthem “Gossip” makes players want to set up—then drop—an LED wall.
1314:92.desc_zh: 需要舞池？这款来自Juelz首张专辑的音乐合集包含新锐锐舞合成器、粗粝贝斯线和强劲陷阱鼓点。《无拘空间》专为CS重制，MVP战歌《流言》能让玩家在瞬间置身于LED幕墙前。

1314:93.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Killer Mike，迈克尔
1314:93.desc_en: Enjoy the 3x GRAMMY Award winning hip-hop album in the world of Counter-Strike. Killer Mike's voice will help keep you motivated as you rise through the ranks and improve your skills.
1314:93.desc_zh: 在CS中畅享三座格莱美奖加冕的嘻哈专辑。Killer Mike的嗓音将激励你攀升段位，精进技巧。

1314:94.desc_en: The only thing we love more than a good enemy? A good soundtrack. Let the new PVRIS music kit hype up your team and keep your victory streak Evergreen.
1314:94.desc_zh: 比击败劲敌更爽的？是完美的战歌。让PVRIS的新音乐盒点燃团队斗志，助你连胜常青。

1314:95.name_en: Music Kit | Selective Response, No Love Only Pleasure
1314:95.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Selective Response，纵欲狂欢
1314:95.desc_en: Drive your desires with this dynamic, high-energy music kit from American techno icon Selective Response. Charged up and ready for action.
1314:95.desc_zh: 美国电子音乐标志人物Selective Response带来的高能动感音乐盒，为你的欲望注入动力，随时准备行动。

1314:96.name_en: Music Kit | Tigercub, The Perfume of Decay
1314:96.desc_en: UK rock outfit Tigercub delivers a gritty melodic punch, fusing raw alt-rock intensity with a brooding modern edge to create a crushing music kit.
1314:96.desc_zh: 英国摇滚乐队 Tigercub 带来了这套风格粗犷又不失旋律感的强劲音乐，融合了原始的另类摇滚张力与阴郁的现代气息，打造出这套碾压级的音乐盒。

1314:98.name_zh: 音乐盒 | ALRT, 多巴胺冲击
1314:98.desc_en: ALRT's bouncy bass house record delivers the ultimate "DOPAMINE HIT", keeping you locked in and ready to rise to the occasion when it matters most.
1314:98.desc_zh: ALRT这首富有弹跳感的贝斯浩室单曲带来了极致“多巴胺冲击”，让你全神贯注，在关键时刻准备好挺身而出。

1314:99.name_en: Music Kit | Altare, Change My Mind
1314:99.name_zh: 音乐盒 | Altare, 吾心不移
1314:99.desc_en: Altare's euphoric wave anthem "Change My Mind" is perfect for the highest of highs when it feels like nobody can stand in your way.
1314:99.desc_zh: Altare这首令人心潮澎湃的浪潮之曲《吾心不移》，最适合在那种感觉无人能阻拦你立于众山之巅的时刻聆听。

14:0.desc_en: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity.
14:0.desc_zh: 强大的野战轻机枪，对于想要以低射速为代价，换取高精准度和高弹容量的玩家来说，M249 是绝佳选择。

14:1042.desc_en:
This M249 has been custom painted in gunmetal grey and finished with a Combine logo.

Overwatch Standard Issue Pulse Rifle
14:1042.desc_zh:
这把 M249 采用了青铜和铁灰色的自定义涂装，绘有一个联合军的标志。

标准制式脉冲步枪

14:1148.desc_en:
It has been tagged with blue and pink arrows pointing in every direction.

A different kind of spray pattern
14:1148.desc_zh:
枪身上绘有蓝色和粉色箭头指向各个方向。

一种不同的喷涂形式

14:120.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with an eye catching black and blue hypnotic design.

"Focus on the sound of my voice"
14:120.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装为引人注目的黑蓝色设计，看起来很催眠。

“专注听我的声音”

14:1242.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using teal-colored desert camouflage and environments as inspiration.

"WE'VE BEEN SET UP! THEY'RE EVERYWHERE!"
14:1242.desc_zh:
这把武器以青色的沙漠伪装和环境为灵感进行了自定义涂装。

“我们被算计了！他们布下了天罗地网！”

14:1298.desc_en:
A green and grey hydrographic pattern has been applied.

"We weren't sure if we were the ambushers... or the ambushees"
14:1298.desc_zh:
枪身采用了灰绿水转印伪装涂装。

“我们分不清自己到底是伏击者……还是猎物”

14:1370.desc_en:
An angular grayscale pattern has been applied.

Rich interiors suited for rough exteriors
14:1370.desc_zh:
采用了棱角分明的灰度纹理。

粗犷外表，适配奢华内构

14:1435.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a purple graphic geometric design.

Stack 'em
14:1435.desc_zh:
它定制涂装了紫色图形化几何图案。

叠吧叠吧

14:151.desc_en: It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a jungle color scheme.
14:151.desc_zh: 这把武器的部分零件以丛林的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

14:170.desc_en: It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.
14:170.desc_zh: 这把武器被漆上了斑纹图案。

14:202.desc_en:
This memento from Ruins has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

Even if you can't see it, you'll definitely hear it
14:202.desc_zh:
这把来自玛雅遗址的纪念武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

未见其枪，先闻其声

14:22.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go
14:22.desc_zh:
这把武器的喷漆采用徒手绘制，线条短粗，对比色彩鲜明。

活跃叛乱者的称手武器

14:243.desc_en: It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.
14:243.desc_zh: 这把武器以网格布为漏字板，徒手进行了喷漆。

14:266.desc_en:
It has copper plated parts that have been masked in a magma pattern and given a red patina using sodium chloride and high heat.  Unmasked areas have subsequently been darkened via oxidization using liver of sulfur.

A burning rate of fire
14:266.desc_zh:
这把武器的镀铜部分使用岩浆图案进行了覆膜，然后使用氯化钠和高温附上了红色的氧化层。未覆膜的部分通过氧化处理，使用了硫肝将其变暗。

岩浆是火焰的助燃剂

14:401.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

Coverfire never looked so good
14:401.desc_zh:
这把武器使用科幻设计进行了自定义涂装。

火力掩护时相当拉风

14:452.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

Who knows what the future holds
14:452.desc_zh:
这把武器使用十二宫的花纹进行了涂装。

没有人能够把握未来

14:472.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a blue and orange color scheme.

The great equalizer
14:472.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以蓝色和橙色的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

伟大的均衡器

14:496.desc_en:
It has been custom painted to look like a classic arcade cabinet.

You can use it, but you better put up a quarter first
14:496.desc_zh:
这把武器使用了自定义涂装，使其看上去就像是经典的街机游戏机。

你当然可以用了，不过首先得投硬币

14:547.desc_en:
It has been painted in a sleek and contemporary manner.

The Phoenix civil war is about to begin
14:547.desc_zh:
这件武器时尚现代。

凤凰内战一触即发

14:648.desc_en:
It has been painted using a hydrographic inspired by a poison dart frog.

Conservation is not a priority
14:648.desc_zh:
这把武器运用了受箭毒蛙灵感启发的水文图案。

保守并非优先事项

14:75.desc_en: It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.
14:75.desc_zh: 这把武器被涂上了大理石纹图案。

14:827.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted with a brown and purple vine and flower pattern.

"What are they keeping in there?"
14:827.desc_zh:
这把武器采用棕色和紫色的藤蔓和花朵图案进行喷涂。

“他们在那里放了啥？”

14:875.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using a green and blue halftone pattern.

This one's off the charts
14:875.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装为绿色和蓝色的半色调图案。

这款设计超乎寻常

14:900.desc_en:
Originally blue with a yellow heat shield, age and use have taken their toll on its appearance.

This old bird deserves a rest
14:900.desc_zh:
曾经是通体青碧带有黄色隔热层，岁月在它的表面烙下了沧桑。

倦鸟虽还岂是休

14:902.desc_en:
Excavated from Aztec ruins, parts of this M249 have rusted and been covered in moss.

Never trust a rope bridge
14:902.desc_zh:
这把M249于阿兹特克遗迹中发掘出来，锈迹斑斑，遍体青苔。

小心吊桥

14:933.collection_name_zh: 2021 炙热沙城 II 收藏品
14:933.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted with black palm fronds over a gray and purple camo.

"The sign says closed!"
14:933.desc_zh:
这把武器在灰色和紫色的迷彩上喷涂了黑色棕榈叶图案。

“牌子上写着已关门！”

14:983.desc_en:
A sand-colored top layer gives way to darker greens the deeper you go. This is a custom paint job you can feel.

How many bullets to get to the center?
14:983.desc_zh:
这是一个诚意满满的定制作品，你完全可以感受得到，看那黄色与深绿的渐变。

让子弹再飞一会儿

16:0.desc_en: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs.
16:0.desc_zh: 与同级的 AK-47 相比更精准，但杀伤力更低，M4A4 是反恐精英可选的全自动突击步枪。

16:101.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Don't be fooled by its simplicity
16:101.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以龙卷风的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

简约而不简单

16:1041.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using neon colors and covered with hand-drawn designs.

Fight for one, fight for all
16:1041.desc_zh:
这把武器采用荧光色进行了自定义涂装，辅以手绘的设计图案。

为一人而战，为所有人而战

16:1063.desc_en:
A custom gold and black paint job with interlocking triangles and blue highlights has been applied.

This alliance is temporary, but you're making me reconsider…
16:1063.desc_zh:
这把武器采用金色和黑色进行了自定义涂装，辅有相互交错的三角形和蓝色加以点缀。

联盟是暂时的，不过你让我重新考虑一下……

16:1097.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a dark blue base and red spider lilies above the magazine and trigger.

Bright colors are a warning, not an invitation
16:1097.desc_zh:
这把武器以深蓝色为基调，弹夹和扳机上方配有红色的彼岸花。

鲜艳的色彩是一种警告，而不是邀请

16:1149.desc_en:
This custom paint job features a clear polymer magazine and a tan colored stock, hand guard, and grip.

Standard operating procedure
16:1149.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了自定义涂装，绘有一个清晰可见的塑料弹匣、褐色枪托、护木以及握把。

标准操作程序

16:1165.desc_en:
It has been custom painted to appear as if it was etched into.

It's just a phase
16:1165.desc_zh:
这把武器的定制涂装让它看起来像被蚀刻过一样。

这只是其中一个阶段而已啦

16:118.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a wine-colored base.

WARNING: Prolonged firing may cause overheating
16:118.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装采用了酒红色底漆。

警告：持续射击可能导致过热

16:1209.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with orange and yellow flames over a black glitter base.

Like hell...
16:1209.desc_zh:
黑闪基底上有跃动的橙黄烈焰定制涂装。

如堕地狱……

16:1210.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using a green camo pattern.

Increase your digital footprint
16:1210.desc_zh:
它采用了绿色数位迷彩涂装。

扩大你的数字足迹

16:1228.desc_en:
A custom paint job in the style of Japanese animation has been applied and depicts a female CT agent fighting against a T-side rush.

"Stand your ground!"
16:1228.desc_zh:
这把武器使用日本动漫风格进行了自定义涂装，图案描绘了一名女性CT探员正与冲锋的T方作战。

“不许动！”

16:1255.desc_en:

"It doesn't look good..."
2:1086.desc_zh:
这把武器采用发动机部件图案进行喷绘。

“看上去不太妙……”

2:1091.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 胶面花纹
2:1091.desc_en:
Both Berettas have been hand etched using a wave pattern. The slides have been painted gold.

Fine details take the longest, add the most, and are noticed the least
2:1091.desc_zh:
这把双持贝瑞塔采用手工蚀刻的波浪图案，且滑套已涂成金色。

精致细节花费时间最长，增加内容最多，但却最容易被忽视

2:112.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 水枪冲击
2:112.desc_en:
It has been custom painted in blue and orange. The droplets imply the weapons may still be wet.

The best weapon is the one your enemies least expect
2:112.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装为蓝色和橙色。水滴效果暗示武器可能仍然是湿的。

最好的武器是你敌人最意想不到的那一把

2:1126.desc_en:
These berettas have been custom painted with a twisted, frightening depiction of a watermelon over a navy blue background.

Sweet dreams...
2:1126.desc_zh:
这把双持贝瑞塔采用扭曲且骇人的自定义涂装，在海军蓝的背景上绘制了西瓜。

美梦……

2:1156.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 食人花
2:1156.desc_en:
Three brightly colored, hungry carnivorous plants have been custom painted on each Dual Beretta.

Help them grow up big and strong
2:1156.desc_zh:
每把贝瑞塔上都绘有3个色彩鲜艳、饥不择食的食肉植物。

助力它们茁壮成长

2:1169.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 藏身处
2:1169.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a multicolored design.

Step right up, don't be shy
2:1169.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了多彩漆色的定制涂装。

过来吧你，别害羞

2:1263.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 蔷薇珠母
2:1263.desc_en:
The metal of these Dual Berettas has been painted rose gold and the grips are a nacred, deep jade color.

You can't make an omelette without cracking a few jeweled eggs
2:1263.desc_zh:
这把双持贝瑞塔的金属部分被涂装成了玫瑰金，握把则是带有珍珠光泽的深玉色。

舍不得孩子套不住狼

2:1290.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 精琢孔雀石
2:1290.desc_en:
These Dual Berettas have been painted with striking green and silver colors. The grips are finished with a ceramic topcoat.

They command respect, although I can't say the same for you... - Booth, Arms Dealer
2:1290.desc_zh:
这对双持贝瑞塔采用了醒目的绿色与银色涂装，握把部分覆有陶瓷面漆。

他们值得尊重，不过对你我可不敢这么说……——布斯，军火商

2:1335.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 第二边界
2:1335.desc_en:
These Dual Berettas have been painted gunmetal grey. The grips have been painted a plum-colored purple.

Table for two?
2:1335.desc_zh:
这把双持贝瑞塔采用枪灰色进行涂装，握把为乌梅紫色。

双人桌？

2:1347.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 天矢之眼
2:1347.desc_en:
They have been custom painted with eyes on the grips and celestial murals on the slides.

Keeping a close eye—or five—on you
2:1347.desc_zh:
这把武器的握把处绘有眼睛图案，滑套部分则饰以天体主题壁画。

用五只——或更多——眼睛紧紧注视着你

2:1373.desc_en:
A grayscale acrylic pour pattern has been applied.

In the end it all seems to come together
2:1373.desc_zh:
采用了灰度亚克力泼墨涂装。

最终，万物皆会汇聚

2:139.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 小甜使
2:139.desc_en:
Two cherubs have been custom painted over a bright-colored graffiti base.

Aww, look how… precious they are
2:139.desc_zh:
两个小天使被涂装在明亮的涂鸦底色上。

哇，看他们多么……珍贵呀

2:1459.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 流金契目
2:1459.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with gold, flowing lines which merge into a desert eye when overlaid.

A shared vision
2:1459.desc_zh:
它采用定制涂装，金色流动线条在双枪拼起时汇聚成沙漠之眼。

共享的视野

2:153.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 爆破能手
2:153.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer
2:153.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件用黑色和蜜桔色进行了喷漆。

罗纳与她对自己的评价一样出色……她只是太年轻，而没有意识到并不该向所有人透露出这点 - 指挥官费利克斯.莱利

2:190.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 黑榄仁木
2:190.desc_en:
This memento from Agency has a dark patina and grips of black limba wood.

Where classic construction meets modern aesthetics
2:190.desc_zh:
这把来自办公大楼的纪念武器拥有菲彩铜绿的颜色和紧握的黑榄仁木图案。

传统建筑学与现代美学的完美结合

2:220.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 血红蛋白
2:220.collection_name_zh: 军火交易 2 号收藏品
2:220.desc_en: It has been painted using a transparent red abstract hydrographic over a metallic base coat.
2:220.desc_zh: 这把武器以金属为外表，通过透明红的抽象花纹进行了涂装。

2:249.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 钴蓝石英
2:249.desc_en:
It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact
2:249.desc_zh:
枪身涂有金属质感喷漆并使用结晶模具压印图案。

谁都想做弄潮儿

2:261.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 海斗士
2:261.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic in a contrasting yellow and blue pattern.

Some people will call you a hero... others a villain
2:261.desc_zh:
这把武器使用对比色彩鲜明的黄色和蓝色图案进行了涂装。

有人称你是英雄… 或是恶棍

2:276.collection_name_zh: 军火交易 3 号收藏品
2:276.desc_en: It has been painted in a black, grey and red color scheme.
2:276.desc_zh: 这把武器使用黑色、灰色和红色的配色图案进行了涂装。

2:28.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 深蓝电镀处理
2:28.desc_en: It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy blue anodized effect paint.
2:28.desc_zh: 这把武器使用铬外表，通过半透明的深蓝电镀处理进行了涂装。

2:307.desc_zh: 这把武器使用军事主题设计图案进行了自定义涂装。

True Love's Kiss can't save you from its barbs

这把武器使用卷曲的藤蔓和花瓣的图案进行了涂装。

“真爱之吻”并不能将你从它的冷嘲热讽中拯救出来。

2:396.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 都市冲击
2:396.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with urban camo and blue accents.

With lightning always comes thunder

这把武器使用都市迷彩和天蓝色调进行了自定义涂装。

电闪雷鸣说的就是它

2:43.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 人工染色
2:43.desc_en:
It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight
2:43.desc_zh:
通过将柠檬汁和芥末滴到这把武器的表面，它被人工地附上了氧化层。

你也许以为刀刃上一团糟，请在黑光灯源下瞧瞧吧

It has been given painted mother-of-pearl grips and a dark forced patina.

Square gum not included

方块口香糖恕不奉送

2:450.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 天秤之月

It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

Today's a great day to find romance and kill your rivals
2:450.desc_zh:
这把武器使用十二宫的花纹进行了涂装。

寻找浪漫，击杀宿敌，就在今天

2:453.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 翡翠色调
2:453.desc_en:
It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent emerald anodized effect paint.

This is what the great Sebastien Hennequet has been reduced to? A nagging school marm?  What happened to you... - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 2
2:453.desc_zh:
这把武器使用铬外表，通过半透明的翡翠电镀处理进行了涂装。

伟大的塞巴斯蒂安.轩尼奎特竟以沦落到如此地步了吗？一个唠叨不停的老学究？你到底是怎么了…… -《导师与偶像破坏者（下）》

2:46.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 雇佣兵
2:46.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted tan, navy and dark green.

Rona Sabri still hasn't forgiven Sebastien for not selecting her to go after Turner
2:46.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件用棕褐色、深蓝色和深绿色进行了喷漆。

罗纳.萨布里依然因塞巴斯蒂安没让她去追杀特纳而耿耿于怀

2:47.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 殖民侵略者
2:47.desc_en: It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey.
2:47.desc_zh: 这把武器的部分零件用黄褐色和灰色进行了喷漆。

2:491.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 龙之双子
2:491.desc_en:
It has dragons laser-etched on the slide and barrel.

Marian was always cooler than Sylvia
2:491.desc_zh:
这把武器的滑套和枪管上有着激光蚀刻的巨龙。

玛丽亚总是比西尔维娅更酷

2:528.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 卡特尔
2:528.desc_en:
It has been engraved with skeletons, flowers and serpents.

That's why Huxley is doing the heavy lifting, all we have to is nudge her forward... - The Serpent and The Truth Seeker, Part 2
2:528.desc_zh:
这把武器被雕刻上了骷髅、鲜花和巨蟒。

这就是赫胥黎为何要完成如此繁重工作的原因，我们现在最该做的就是引导她向前… -《毒蛇与真理追寻者（下）》

2:544.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 通风机
2:544.desc_en:
These pistols have been elegantly painted in chrome.

A weapon for artists, by artists
2:544.desc_zh:
这两把手枪使用银色涂装，典雅精致。

艺术家之作，艺术家之属的武器

2:625.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 皇室伴侣
2:625.desc_en:
Between the green dyed pearl handled grips, gryphon side plates, and laser etched slide; these pistols redefine elegance.

Face off and release the doves
2:625.desc_zh:
有着绿色染色珍珠处理的握把、狮鹫图案的侧板和激光蚀刻的滑套做装饰，这副双枪重新定义了优雅。

开始放飞鸽子吧

2:658.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 毒蛇袭击
2:658.desc_en:
A cobra has been hand painted on either grip. The slide displays its neon venom.

They always strike back
2:658.desc_zh:
两边握把上都运用了眼镜蛇图案。套筒上展示着荧光色毒液。

它们总会反咬一口

It has been spray painted with white and blue streaks on a black base.

Sometimes the gnar shreds you
2:710.desc_zh:
这把武器在黑色基础上喷涂了白蓝相间的条纹。

时时挑战极限

2:747.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 双涡轮
2:747.desc_en:
A custom paint job paying homage to an Italian racing car has been applied.

Always an underdog
2:747.desc_zh:
这把武器的定绘意义在于向一种意大利赛车致敬。

败者的荣光

2:824.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using brown paint in a pattern resembling dried wood.

Knock on wood; you're gonna need all the luck you can get - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer
2:824.desc_zh:
这把武器采用类似干燥木材的棕色图案进行了喷涂。

好运来！你会需要所有你能得到的运气。- 指挥官费利克斯·莱利

2:860.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 熊熊烈焰
2:860.desc_en:
It has been painted using a rust-tinted hydrographic of a gel pen doodle.

Honor your dead
2:860.desc_zh:
枪身用中性笔绘制了铁锈色的花纹。

死者为大

2:895.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 左右开花
2:895.desc_en:
A red rose has been painted on either grip over a black base and silver filigree.

In all things
2:895.desc_zh:
黑色的枪身握把上印有红玫瑰，并附加银丝工艺。

天下万物

ELITE has been stamped on the side of these classic Dual Berettas.

Source material
2:903.desc_zh:
双持贝瑞塔两侧刻上了“精英”的字样。

经典复刻

2:978.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a high tech black, white, and red design.

Always follow manufacturer guidelines for safe use
2:978.desc_zh:
这把武器采用高科技质感的黑、白、红三色花纹定制。

始终遵守制造商的安全使用指南

2:998.name_zh: 双持贝瑞塔 | 暗网总机
2:998.desc_en:
A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do
2:998.desc_zh:
枪身饰有彩色数字花纹。

数字不会说谎，但我会

23:0.desc_en: Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet.
23:0.desc_zh: 一直被模仿，但从未被超越。经典的 MP5 也许是世界上用法最通用、最受欢迎的微型冲锋枪。此 SD 变种最大特点在于已配有消音器，本已令人胆寒的武器如今杀人于无声之间。

23:1061.desc_en:
A red and tan hydrographic pattern of assorted designs has been applied.

Last chance; train's leaving the station
23:1061.desc_zh:
这把武器绘有红色和棕褐色的各种图案

最后机会，火车即将离站

23:1137.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with fairytale inspired creatures and a chicken on the silencer.

Playtime is over!
23:1137.desc_zh:
这把武器进行了自定义涂装，枪身绘制了一些小怪物，并在消音器上绘制了一只小鸡。

游戏时间结束！

23:1180.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a black and blue design.

Black and blue and bloody all over
23:1180.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装为黑色和蓝色的设计。

又黑又蓝，淤青斑斑

23:1231.desc_en:
Its dark base and carefully selected red and blue highlights make this custom painted MP5-SD appear as if it's glowing under ambient light.

Quiet reflection
23:1231.desc_zh:
它的深色底座和精心挑选的红色和蓝色亮点使这款自定义涂装的MP5-SD在环境光线下看起来就像发光一样。

静心思考

23:1274.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted with a blue and green hex pattern.

Hex marks the spot
23:1274.desc_zh:
它采用了蓝绿六边形喷绘。

六边形战士在此

23:1294.desc_en:
A green and gold hydrographic camo pattern has been applied.

"Can you take that outside?"
23:1294.desc_zh:
枪身采用了绿金水转迷彩。

“能去外面弄吗？”

23:1344.desc_en:
It has been custom painted in gunmetal grey and finished with red accents.

STAY FOCUSED // TRUE AIM
23:1344.desc_zh:
这把武器的定制涂装以枪灰色为基底，并辅以红色点缀。

保持专注 // 精确瞄准

23:1366.desc_en:
A grayscale pattern featuring sharp, angular designs has been applied.

Unflinching
23:1366.desc_zh:
采用了锐利棱角设计的灰度涂装。

坚定不移

23:1385.desc_en:
A red pattern of offset X's has been applied.

It's a bit much, but isn't that the point? - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training
23:1385.desc_zh:
采用了错位 X 形红色纹理涂装。

有点浮夸，但这不正是重点吗？——实习军火商伊莫金

23:161.desc_en:
Neon-colored paint pen graffiti doodles have been applied over a dark base.

"It's art, I shouldn’t have to explain it"
23:161.desc_zh:
在深色底色上涂有霓虹色彩的油漆笔涂鸦。

“这是艺术，无需解释”

23:753.desc_en:
Black streaks have been spray painted over a dark base.

Dirt don't hurt… until it does
23:753.desc_zh:
这把武器在暗色调基础上喷绘了黑色条纹。

尘土扬起，危机四伏

It has been custom painted using a sand and olive-colored halftone design.

Observe in silence, then make yourself known
23:768.desc_zh:
这款涂装采用了沙色和橄榄色的半色调设计。

静观其变，然后展露锋芒

23:781.desc_en:
A blue circuit board pattern been applied.

Silently supplementing
23:781.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了蓝色电路板图案。

默默补充

23:798.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer
23:798.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件用黑色和蜜桔色进行了喷漆。

罗纳与她对自己的评价一样出色……她只是太年轻，而没有意识到并不该向所有人透露出这点 - 指挥官费利克斯.莱利

23:800.desc_en:
It features a hydrographic pattern depicting a mischief of rats.

—REDACTED—
23:800.desc_zh:
主要描绘了老鼠恶作剧的花纹图案

 ——删除真相——

23:810.desc_en:
It has been custom painted by dripping neon pink, green, and teal paint onto its dark base.

Stand out from the crowd
23:810.desc_zh:
这把武器在暗色底座上，用滴落效果涂上了荧光粉色、绿色和蓝绿色。

从人群中脱颖而出

23:846.desc_en:
It has been custom painted to look like it was assembled from pieces of stamped steel.

Lovingly referred to as the "SpaceGat 2000"
23:846.desc_zh:
枪身仿佛由数片冲压钢组装而成.

亲切地被称为 "SpaceGat 2000"

23:872.desc_en:
It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.

Insert shoot pun here
23:872.desc_zh:
表面喷绘有水墨画制的竹子花纹。

至少它不是玩具枪

Prior to assembly its metallic blue topcoat was exposed to acid. It has been finished with brass hardware.

Black and blue and brass all over
23:888.desc_zh:
枪身附有金属光泽的蓝色表层涂料，类似强酸腐蚀的视觉效果。最后用黄铜加以点缀。

全身青一块紫一块

23:915.desc_en:
It has been custom painted in FBI blue and finished with yellow accents.

"It's time to earn our stories"
23:915.desc_zh:
这把武器使用了自定义涂装，通体美国联邦调查局蓝色色调，突出黄色标记。

“是时候来书写我们的故事了”

23:923.desc_en:
A brightly-colored orange and teal camouflage pattern has been applied. The weapon has been finished with gold accents.

A weapon this quiet shouldn't be so loud
23:923.desc_zh:
这把武器绘有鲜艳的橙色和蓝绿色迷彩图案，并用金色点缀加以装饰。

这么安静的一把武器不应该如此喧嚣

23:949.desc_en:
