42:0.desc_en: Quiet and always available, the knife has a fast, low-damage primary attack and a slow, high-damage secondary attack. A backstab will earn quiet players an instant kill.
42:0.desc_zh: 杀人于悄无声息之中，且永远可用，匕首拥有快速、低伤害的主要攻击和较慢、高伤害的次要攻击。背刺能使玩家在悄然无声之中对敌人造成“秒杀”。

43:0.desc_en: The non-lethal flashbang grenade temporarily blinds anybody within its concussive blast, making it perfect for flushing out closed-in areas. Its loud explosion also temporarily masks the sound of footsteps.
43:0.desc_zh: 非致命的闪光震撼弹能在其震撼爆炸时，暂时致盲所有看见它的人，非常适合用它来进行突围。其巨大的爆炸声还可以暂时掩盖脚步声。

44:0.desc_en: The high explosive fragmentation grenade administers high damage through a wide area, making it ideal for clearing out hostile rooms.
44:0.desc_zh: 高爆破片手雷能在大范围内造成较高的伤害，非常适合把它扔到满是敌人的屋子里。

45:0.desc_en: The smoke grenade creates a medium-area smoke screen. It can effectively hide your team from snipers, or even just create a useful distraction.
45:0.desc_zh: 烟雾弹能够制造出一片中等范围的烟雾屏障。它能有效的将你的团队在狙击手面前隐蔽起来，或只是分散敌人的注意力。

46:0.desc_en: The Molotov is a powerful and unpredictable area denial weapon that bursts into flames when thrown on the ground, injuring any player in its radius.
46:0.desc_zh: 燃烧瓶是强大而又难以捉摸的区域封锁武器，其可在接触地面的瞬间爆炸起火，伤害任何在其作用范围内玩家。

4613:0.name_en: Agent | Bloody Darryl The Strapped | The Professionals
4613:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔（穷鬼）| 专业人士
4613:0.desc_en:
Before he was leader of the heist gang 'The Professionals' Sir Bloody Darryl was more simply called, Bloody Darryl. Still your friendly neighborhood psychopath in every sense of the word. Not actually Australian according to Australians. 

I'm just gonna give them a bit of Razzle Dazzle.
4613:0.desc_zh:
在他成为抢劫团伙"专业人士"首领之前，残酷的达里尔爵士简称为“残酷的达里尔”。从各种意义上讲，他仍是你的好邻居兼精神病患者。据澳洲人所说，实际上他并不是澳洲人。

我只是要给他们来点花式炫技。

4619:0.name_zh: 探员 | “蓝莓” 铅弹 | 海军水面战中心海豹部队
4619:0.desc_en:
Known as SEAL Team's "Weapons Sommelier" Buckshot has thoroughly field-tested and reviewed almost every available military weapon in staggering depth. ST6 relies on Buckshot's knowledge of lesser-known guns for edge case advantages in ground based operations.

Seen here sporting the classic NUE Type 1 uniform otherwise known as 'blueberries'. 

They talk to me. The guns. They have feelings.
4619:0.desc_zh:
作为海豹部队的“武器品鉴师”，铅弹已经全面而细致地评测过几乎所有可用的军事武器。海豹突击队第六分队依靠其在小众枪支领域中的知识，频频在地面作战行动中取得优势。

他身上的这件经典款NUE1型制服又被称为“蓝莓”。

枪是有灵性的，能与我沟通。

4680:0.name_zh: 探员 | “两次”麦考伊 | 战术空中管制部队装甲兵
4680:0.desc_en:
'Two Times' McCoy earned his nickname by completing TACP's field training twice. Official records mark this up to a scheduling mix-up, but his teammates report restraining him from completing the trifecta.

With inhuman reserves of physical and mental stamina, McCoy often finds himself the last person standing at the end of any conflict—physical and verbal alike.

His yellow scarf is a tribute to his time with 1st Cavalry Division.

Yep. Still here.
4680:0.desc_zh:
在海豹部队完成两次臭名昭著的地狱周末训练后，麦考伊被人取了个外号。不太确定是出于安排上的混乱，还是说他享受这个过程。

总之，麦考伊拥有超出常人的体力和意志力。他常常发现，自己就是那个总能在各种打斗中坚持到最后一刻的人。他的黄领巾是对他在第一骑兵师的纪念。

没错，他还在。

47:0.desc_en: When thrown, the decoy grenade emulates the sound of the most powerful weapon you are carrying, creating the illusion of additional supporting forces.
47:0.desc_zh: 掷出后，诱饵弹能模拟出你所携带的威力最大的武器的声音，给敌人创造出额外支援火力的幻觉。

4711:0.name_en: Agent | Cmdr. Mae 'Dead Cold' Jamison | SWAT
4711:0.name_zh: 探员 | 指挥官 梅 “极寒” 贾米森 | 特警
4711:0.desc_en:
Cmdr. 'Dead Cold' Jamison has just about seen it all. Skeptical and wry in the midst of deadly combat, others could mistake her for being nonchalant about the chaos at hand. They would be wrong. Nothing gets past Dead Cold, not bad guys with AK-47s, junior officers that call her 'Ma'am,' or an opportunity to make elite officers smirk under pressure.

You're gonna find out.
4711:0.desc_zh:
指挥官梅“极寒”贾米森已经看穿了一切。由于她常在重要行动中表现出挖苦和刻薄态度，人们总误以为她是那种无法控制混乱局面的人。但其实他们错了，没有什么可以逃出这位指挥官的法眼，尤其是那些手持AK-47的坏蛋。每当那些年轻下级军官称呼她为“女士”时，她队伍里的精英队员们都会忍俊不禁，这算是高压生活下的一点小乐趣吧。

你们终究会懂我的。

4712:0.name_zh: 探员 | 第一中尉法洛 | 特警
4712:0.desc_en:
Smart as a whip and relentlessly polite, 1st Lieutenant Farlow is one of the most beloved and respected officers in SWAT. A master tactician in hostage and barricade situations, Farlow quickly climbed the SWAT ranks. Don't be fooled by her overwhelmingly cheerful nature--she can dispatch bad guys in the blink of an eye and not think twice about it.

What are they doing over there? Drinking milkshakes?
4712:0.desc_zh:
第一中尉法洛是一个彬彬有礼的小机灵鬼，她是特警队里最受欢迎、最受爱戴的军官之一。法洛被称为障碍排除及解救人质的战术大师，这让她很快在队内得到提拔。不要被她天性开朗的外表所欺骗，她可是拥有能在一瞬间搞定敌人的本领，行动果敢而迅速。

他们在那里搞什么呢？喝奶昔？！

4713:0.name_zh: 探员 | 约翰 “范·海伦” 卡斯克 | 特警
4713:0.desc_en:
John 'Van Healen' Kask is one of SWATs best tactical defence units and on-site military paramedics. He also shreds a mean guitar—sometimes mid-operation. He says it helps get his teammates' blood pumping just as effectively as an AED, which he keeps ready in case of emergency. 

I can bring you back to life, but I can't make you live.
4713:0.desc_zh:
约翰 “范·海伦” 卡斯克是特警队中最好的战术防卫及现场护理专员之一。他弹得一手好吉他——有时，甚至在任务行动中也不放弃演奏…… 据他说，在行动中弹吉能令队友兴奋起来，起到体外除颤器的作用，所以他常年随身携带吉他，以备不时之需。

我可以让你起死回生，但不包括我的敌人。

4714:0.name_zh: 探员 | 生物防害专家 | 特警
4714:0.desc_en:
The SWAT's Biological Hazard Specialists are trained to handle worst case bio warfare situations. Terrorists planning to unleash a bio hazard attack upon unsuspecting civilians do not want to deal with these guys.

Tacita Sed Mortiferum.
4714:0.desc_zh:
这位特警队里的生物防害专家，接受过培训，可以处理哪怕最坏情况的生物战。对于那些计划向毫无戒备的普通百姓进行生害攻击的T来说，这些生物防害专家简直就是最头痛的对手。

安静但致命！

4715:0.name_zh: 探员 | 军士长炸弹森 | 特警
4715:0.desc_en:
Tyler Bobson earned his moniker after becoming SWAT's go-to officer for efficient Explosive Ordnance Disposal. With his uncanny ability to locate even the most well hidden IEDs, Bombson's keen hearing is outclassed only by the noble Greater Wax Moth.

Yeah, I heard that.
4715:0.desc_zh:
泰勒·炸弹森在特警队中凭借高超的排爆水平，为他赢得了自己的绰号。他具有敏锐到不可思议的听觉，哪怕是再隐蔽的爆炸装置，都可以精准定位，可能只有大蜡螟的听力才能超过他。

是的！我已经锁定了炸弹！

4716:0.name_zh: 探员 | 化学防害专家 | 特警
4716:0.desc_en:
The SWAT Chemical Hazard Specialists are able to survive and succeed in toxic environment operations for hours at a time. Where others run away, they run in.

Feels like home.
4716:0.desc_zh:
这位特警队里的化学防害专家，可以在有毒环境中成功连续生存数小时。他们是逆行者，当别人拼命逃离时，他们往往要冲进去。

如此熟悉的感觉！

4718:0.name_zh: 探员 | 红衫列赞 | 军刀
4718:0.desc_en:
An expert grenadier and the once-celebrated author of The Joy of Preparedness, Rezan the Redshirt is Sabre's self-appointed Head of Operations.

Over time, Rezan has learned to control his fiery temper—now he wears his explosive rage on his sleeves.

I take great pride in my work.
4718:0.desc_zh:
列赞是一位专业的投弹手兼前畅销书作家，他自诩为军刀组织里的行动负责人。

渐渐地，雷赞已经学会了控制自己火爆的脾气，现在，他衣袖上的臂章记录了他过去的暴脾气。

我工作，我自豪。

4725:0.desc_en: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.
4725:0.desc_zh: 这副露指手套使用金属铆钉和“狂牙大行动”的图标进行了装饰。

4725:10086.name_zh: 狂牙手套 | 黄色斑纹

4725:10088.name_zh: 狂牙手套 | 精神错乱

4726:0.name_en: Agent | Sir Bloody Miami Darryl | The Professionals
4726:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔爵士（迈阿密）| 专业人士
4726:0.desc_en:
The leader of 'The Professionals' can be described as cocky, wisecracking, and scarily indifferent with regards to the suffering of others. He would say he's just a bloke—a bloke that likes to have a bit of fun on the weekend with the local armed tax collectors. He downplays the severity of any heavy situations that come his way, even if he's the last man standing, riddled with bullets, with only seconds left to blow the safe.

This white hockey mask and floral shirt were popular choices during his Vice phase. 

Got my hair combed back and my sunglasses on.
4726:0.desc_zh:
这位臭名昭著的打劫团伙“专业人士”的领导者，傲慢、聪明又极其冷漠，特别是在对他人的痛苦方面。他自称自己只是一个喜欢在周末给当地武装税务人员找乐子的家伙。他对面临的任何问题都嗤之以鼻，不管那个问题有多么严重，即使这意味着他在火拼后孤身一人，身体被打成筛子，或炸开保险箱的时间只剩几秒，他也完全不在乎。

这个白色冰球面具和花衬衫是他恶人生涯中最爱的装扮。

梳个大背头，带个太阳镜

4727:0.name_zh: 探员 | 飞贼波兹曼 | 专业人士
4727:0.desc_en:
Weird, quirky, unhinged; a few words that describe The Professionals' safecracker and technical mastermind. When she is not mumbling to herself about the flawed assumptions inherent within the profit maximization paradox, Safecracker serves as a morally questionable but highly efficient 'fundraising expert.' She enjoys short walks on pavement, the sound of cable ties being fastened, and testing explosive prototypes under immense pressure.

Don't blow it. DO blow the bomb though, okay? We do want that.
4727:0.desc_zh:
古怪、另类、混乱，这些词语都能很好地描述这位专业人士，身兼保险箱窃贼与技术大脑于一体。当她没有嘟囔那些关于利润最大化悖论中存在的错误假设时，她还算是效率最高的五个“道德有问题”的“筹款专家”之一。她喜欢在人行道上散步，喜欢捆电缆的声音，喜欢在高强度压力下测试爆炸试验品。

别浪费时间，赶快引爆炸弹，好吗！我们就想要这么干！

4728:0.name_zh: 探员 | 小凯夫 | 专业人士
4728:0.desc_en:
The Professional who makes heavy weapons look weightless, Little Kev is the soft spoken 'little' brother of Sir Bloody Darryl. His older brother's bodyguard since age 5, Little Kev developed a knack for quelling 'people problems' before they arise. Sir Darryl assigned him Human Resources Manager for the entire Professionals organization.  

We're getting this done either way.
4728:0.desc_zh:
小凯夫身材高大魁梧，是唯一一个足以令手中的重型武器看起来都像小玩具的“专业人士”，他也被称为残酷的达里尔爵士的“小”弟弟。他从5岁开始担任哥哥的贴身保镖，悟出了一套在“问题”萌芽之前就将其扼杀在摇篮中的办法。在达里尔爵士发现了弟弟的这个天赋后，便指派他担任整个组织里的人力资源经理。

无论如何，我们都要完成这个任务。

4730:0.name_zh: 探员 | 出逃的萨莉 | 专业人士
4730:0.desc_en:
Small enough to hide in plain sight but loud enough to frighten the biggest enemies, Getaway Sally is The Professionals' first pick for tight quarter Wealth Acquisition Projects.  A talented weaver of controlled chaos, Getaway Sally has the improvisational skills to turn the tables on any dire heist and hostage situations. 

Now you don't see me, and now you still don't.
4730:0.desc_zh:
出逃的萨莉是“专业人士”组织里执行机密行动的不二选择，她小到可以藏在任何地方，但声音大到可以唬住任何敌人。她是天才的混乱处理专员，无论多么糟糕的抢劫或劫持情况，她都能借助自己的应变能力，迅速而从容的扭转乾坤。

我又跳出来了, 我又进来了! 打我啊！

4732:0.name_zh: 探员 | 老K | 专业人士
4732:0.desc_en:
In his 'Wealth Acquisition Specialist' application form, Number K wrote the letter 'K' in every number field, but his talent with handguns made him more than qualified for the position. Number K keeps the details of his life private—none of his colleagues have seen his face—making him one of The Professionals' most feared heist managers.

Don't count us down. Just say go.
4732:0.desc_zh:
在“财务获取专家”工作申请表上，老K在任何需要填数字的地方，都只是简单的写上字母K。没人知道这代表什么。尽管如此，老K的手枪水平令他完全胜任这个职位。他非常强调自己的隐私——甚至没有任何一个同事看过他的脸——这使他成为最令人闻风丧胆的“专业人士”之一。

别把我们算在内。咱说走就走。

4733:0.name_en: Agent | Sir Bloody Silent Darryl | The Professionals
4733:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔爵士（沉默）| 专业人士
4733:0.desc_en:
The leader of 'The Professionals' can be described as cocky, wisecracking, and scarily indifferent with regards to the suffering of others. He would say he's just a bloke—a bloke that likes to have a bit of fun on the weekend with the local armed tax collectors. He downplays the severity of any heavy situations that come his way, even if he's the last man standing, riddled with bullets, with only seconds left to blow the safe.

This 'Vow of Silence' mask was Darryl's response to organizational complaints about his logorrhea. 

...
4733:0.desc_zh:
这位臭名昭著的打劫团伙“专业人士”的领导者，傲慢、聪明又极其冷漠，特别是在对他人的痛苦方面。他自称自己只是一个喜欢在周末给当地武装税务人员找乐子的家伙。他对面临的任何问题都嗤之以鼻，不管那个问题有多么严重，即使这意味着他在火拼后孤身一人，身体被打成筛子，或炸开保险箱的时间只剩几秒，他也完全不在乎。

这个“沉默之誓”面具代表了达里尔对组织嫌弃他聒噪的一种回应。

……

4734:0.name_en: Agent | Sir Bloody Skullhead Darryl | The Professionals
4734:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔爵士（头盖骨）| 专业人士
4734:0.desc_en:
The leader of 'The Professionals' can be described as cocky, wisecracking, and scarily indifferent with regards to the suffering of others. He would say he's just a bloke—a bloke that likes to have a bit of fun on the weekend with the local armed tax collectors. He downplays the severity of any heavy situations that come his way, even if he's the last man standing, riddled with bullets, with only seconds left to blow the safe.

This black mask has been painted with a white skull, a useful bit of intimidation back when The Professionals were just getting started. 

Are we gonna bloody finish this thing or what?!
4734:0.desc_zh:
这位臭名昭著的打劫团伙“专业人士”的领导者，傲慢、聪明又极其冷漠，特别是在对他人的痛苦方面。他自称自己只是一个喜欢在周末给当地武装税务人员找乐子的家伙。他对面临的任何问题都嗤之以鼻，不管那个问题有多么严重，即使这意味着他在火拼后孤身一人，身体被打成筛子，或炸开保险箱的时间只剩几秒，他也完全不在乎。

这个黑色面具带有白色骷髅纹饰，在“专业人士”组织成立初期，这些骷髅纹饰还是相当有震慑效果的。

我们要把这件事干完还是怎样？

4735:0.name_en: Agent | Sir Bloody Darryl Royale | The Professionals
4735:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔爵士（皇家）| 专业人士
4735:0.desc_en:
The leader of 'The Professionals' can be described as cocky, wisecracking, and scarily indifferent with regards to the suffering of others. He would say he's just a bloke—a bloke that likes to have a bit of fun on the weekend with the local armed tax collectors. He downplays the severity of any heavy situations that come his way, even if he's the last man standing, riddled with bullets, with only seconds left to blow the safe.

This gold mask with a crown stencil commemorates The Professionals' first visit to Monaco. 

Do you know what they call a cheeseburger in Monaco?
4735:0.desc_zh:
这位臭名昭著的打劫团伙“专业人士”的领导者，傲慢、聪明又极其冷漠，特别是在对他人的痛苦方面。他自称自己只是一个喜欢在周末给当地武装税务人员找乐子的家伙。他对面临的任何问题都嗤之以鼻，不管那个问题有多么严重，即使这意味着他在火拼后孤身一人，身体被打成筛子，或炸开保险箱的时间只剩几秒，他也完全不在乎。

这个黄金面具带有皇冠图案，是为了纪念当年“专业人士”的首次摩纳哥之行。

你知道摩纳哥人管芝士汉堡叫啥吗？

4736:0.name_en: Agent | Sir Bloody Loudmouth Darryl | The Professionals
4736:0.name_zh: 探员 | 残酷的达里尔爵士（聒噪）| 专业人士
4736:0.desc_en:
The leader of 'The Professionals' can be described as cocky, wisecracking, and scarily indifferent with regards to the suffering of others. He would say he's just a bloke—a bloke that likes to have a bit of fun on the weekend with the local armed tax collectors. He downplays the severity of any heavy situations that come his way, even if he's the last man standing, riddled with bullets, with only seconds left to blow the safe.

This mask has been painted with clown makeup, perfect for taking candy from rich spoiled babies. 

...The crying on the inside kind, I guess.
4736:0.desc_zh:
这位臭名昭著的打劫团伙“专业人士”的领导者，傲慢、聪明又极其冷漠，特别是在对他人的痛苦方面。他自称自己只是一个喜欢在周末给当地武装税务人员找乐子的家伙。他对面临的任何问题都嗤之以鼻，不管那个问题有多么严重，即使这意味着他在火拼后孤身一人，身体被打成筛子，或炸开保险箱的时间只剩几秒，他也完全不在乎。

这个带有小丑妆风格的面具，非常适合装扮起来，从那些娇气的富贵宝宝们手里抢走糖果。

人生远看是喜剧,近看是悲剧。

4749:0.name_zh: 探员 | 军医少尉 | 法国宪兵特勤队
4749:0.desc_en:
Medics of the Gendarmerie National have a well-deserved reputation for providing life saving interventions using anything at their disposal. From improvised AEDs to jungle medicine to precise covering fire, the medics of the Gendarm have your back—no matter what. 

 It is better to prevent than to heal.
4749:0.desc_zh:
作为法国宪兵队的医务人员，拥有较高的声望，可以充分利用和调动现场各种资源提供救援：譬如临时拼凑出体外除颤仪、丛林药剂、甚至提供精准的火力掩护，无论你遇到什么困难，医疗队员随时待命。

顺其自然，防患于未然

4750:0.name_zh: 探员 | 化学防害上尉| 法国宪兵特勤队
4750:0.desc_en:
As leader for Chemical and BioHazard combat operations in populated areas, the Gendarmerie Chem-Haz Capitaine plays a crucial role within the organization. Celebrated for orchestrating the successful rescue of an entire domestic airport's civilian occupancy in the infamous sarin gas attack of 1997, the Chem-Haz Capitaine is the epitome of preparedness and composure.    

Don't forget to breathe.
4750:0.desc_zh:
法国宪兵特勤队化学防害上尉，是组织中的领导人物，负责领导和指挥特勤队在人口密集区打击化学和生物危害袭击。最著名的一次行动是在1997年发生的臭名昭著的沙林毒气袭击中成功营救和保护了一整个国内机场的平民。自此，上尉便成为了沉着冷静的代名词。

冷静，去感受呼吸。

4751:0.name_en: Agent | Chef d'Escadron Rouchard | Gendarmerie Nationale
4751:0.name_zh: 探员 | 中队长鲁沙尔·勒库托 | 法国宪兵特勤队
4751:0.desc_en:
Born into an old aristocratic family, Rouchard enlisted in the Gendarmerie Nationale at her first opportunity as a way to avoid compulsory enrollment at a notorious Swiss finishing school for young women. As Aspirant in the Gendarmerie, Rouchard quickly impressed her senior ranks by excelling in offensive strategy and hostage negotiations, but most of all, blade-based combat. Several promotions later she is best known by her moniker 'Le Couteau' (The Knife), although some would say this is because she can be a bit blunt at times. Today, Rouchard gets called in when no one else knows what to do. 

It is but a scratch.
4751:0.desc_zh:
鲁沙尔出身于一个古老的贵族家庭，为了避免被强制送到一所臭名昭著的瑞士女子学校，她报名了法国宪兵队，并抓住了这第一次的机会，成功加入了宪兵队。作为准尉的她，善于进攻战略布局、人质谈判营救，同时又擅长刀锋类武器的格斗，这些特质都深得长官们的青睐。在几次晋升之后，她被大家称为“丽刃”。虽然有人觉得她有时会不近人情，不过在当前，当没人知道该做什么的时候，她就会成为下一步行动的最佳人选。

毛毛雨而已。

4752:0.name_zh: 探员 | 准尉 | 法国宪兵特勤队
4752:0.desc_en:
Aspirants of the Gendarmerie are highly trained military police cadets responsible for assisting in rural combat operations. To say most are eager for action in the field is an understatement.   

C'est la vie.
4752:0.desc_zh:
宪兵队的准尉均为训练有素的军警学员，负责协助农村地区的作战行动。他们的目标不止是原野里的行动，还有星辰大海。

这就是命啊。

4753:0.name_en: Agent | Officer Jacques Beltram | Gendarmerie Nationale
4753:0.name_zh: 探员 | 军官雅克·贝尔特朗 | 法国宪兵特勤队
4753:0.desc_en:
A highly decorated Officer for the Gendarmerie, Beltram was awarded the Legion of Honor for swapping places with a hostage and thwarting terrorist activity on more than one occasion. Beltram is a hero, a single father, and a passionate consumer of pain au chocolate at all times of day.  

We do what we have to do.
4753:0.desc_zh:
贝尔特朗是宪兵队的一名荣誉军官，因多次交换人质同时伺机化解了恐怖活动而被授予荣誉军团的称号。一个英雄、同时，又是一个单身父亲，以及全天候的巧克力面包控。

我做了那么多改变，只为心中不变。

4756:0.name_zh: 探员 | 中尉法洛（抱树人） | 特警
4756:0.desc_en:
No one else knows how to enjoy combat ops that require sunscreen, mosquito repellant and M4A4 assault rifles quite like Farlow does. 

Kinda nice to get out of the cold don't ya think?
4756:0.desc_zh:
没有人像法洛那样知道如何享受战斗。行动中他仅仅需要 M4A4 突击步枪，他还需要防晒霜和驱蚊剂。

摆脱寒冷的感觉真好，你不觉得吗？

4757:0.name_en: Agent | Cmdr. Davida 'Goggles' Fernandez | SEAL Frogman
4757:0.name_zh: 探员 | 指挥官黛维达·费尔南德斯（护目镜） | 海豹蛙人
4757:0.desc_en:
Possessing an exquisite mammalian dive reflex, Cmdr. Fernandez is able to slow her heart rate to undetectable levels and navigate darkness, ice, and deep sea defense systems. She excels in her human aquatic potential and her skill as an elite marksman and soldier. 'Goggles' earned her nickname when a bullet struck her left eye—or would have—if it weren't for 'Wet Sox' reminding her to grab her full kit 'for the last time!' Despite her occasional forgetfulness, Cmdr. Fernandez is one of two elite combat diver SEALs to be awarded The Navy Cross for classified underwater operations. 

Be still my beating heart.
4757:0.desc_zh:
指挥官费尔南德斯拥有一种神奇的哺乳动物潜水反射，能够将心率降低到无法被侦测到的水平，并可在黑暗、冰层或深海防御系统中潜行。她善于利用自己的水上能力，并拥有优秀的射击技能和士兵素养。曾经，一颗子弹射穿了她左眼的“护目镜”，或者说，若不是“湿袜”最后一次提醒拿好她的全套装备，她的左眼或许不会被打中 ，这为她赢得了她的绰号。虽然偶有健忘，但她与另外一名同伴因多次成功执行水下秘密行动而被授予海军十字勋章。

我心永恒。

4771:0.name_en: Agent | Cmdr. Frank 'Wet Sox' Baroud | SEAL Frogman
4771:0.name_zh: 探员 | 指挥官弗兰克·巴鲁德（湿袜） | 海豹蛙人
4771:0.desc_en:
First on deck and last off it, Cmdr. Frank Baroud is a third generation SEAL and second combat diver ever to receive The Navy Cross medal; 'Goggles' was the first. Count on Baroud to solve the most complicated underwater and ground based conflict situations, like the time he defused several IED's which were planted in a network of flooded caves beneath a US embassy. Baroud chalks it up to his impeccable attention to detail, because after all, when your life depends on the equipment you're wearing, a simple mistake may be the last one you make. His uncompromising attention to detail earned him the nickname 'Wet Sox'.

Double check it. Then triple check it. Then check it again.
4771:0.desc_zh:
指挥官弗兰克·巴鲁德起先在甲板作业，之后被派到水下执行任务，是第三代海豹突击队员，也是继“护目镜”费尔南德斯指挥官后第二位获得海军十字勋章的战斗潜水员。他经常被派往解决最为复杂的水下和地面任务。例如潜到美国使馆下方被水淹没的复杂洞穴线路中拆除爆炸装置。巴鲁德觉得这一切都归因于自己对于细节的执念。毕竟，当你决定把命交给你身上那套装备的时候，一个微小的失误都可能要命。然而同时，这个特质也让他对于自己的潜水伙伴来讲有点扫兴，所以身边伙伴为他起了个绰号“湿袜”。

一次检查，两次检查，三次检查……无限次检查。

4772:0.name_en: Agent | Lieutenant Rex Krikey | SEAL Frogman
4772:0.name_zh: 探员 | 中尉雷克斯·克里奇 | 海豹蛙人
4772:0.desc_en:
Lieutenant Krikey is a prime choice for all jungle and wetlands combat operations. His expertise in handling wild reptiles big and small has saved both him and his fellow frogmen on more than one occasion.

I'm just an apex predator that enjoys meeting other apex predators.
4772:0.desc_zh:
克里奇中尉是所有丛林和湿地作战行动的首选。他在处理大型野生爬行动物方面的专长，不止一次拯救了他和他的蛙人同伴。

我只是一个站在食物链顶端的男人，但求一败！

4773:0.name_en: Agent | Elite Trapper Solman | Guerrilla Warfare
4773:0.name_zh: 探员 | 精锐捕兽者索尔曼 | 游击队
4773:0.desc_en:
On a hot summer day on the outskirt islands of the Caribbean, Solman, relaxing on a small yet expensive vacation tour, was taken hostage by the infamous Guerrilla Warfare (GW). Overhearing his captors talk about the division of ransom money, Solman negotiated his own release if he delivered three additional hostages within 24 hours. And deliver he did, armed with only money, charm, and a way with words reserved for the world's most horrific cult leaders. Stunned by his lack of empathy for his fellow tourists and his ability to deliver a steady supply of 'ransom units' (people) the GW negotiated a position for Solman among them. Taking the highest percentage of hostage random money of any member of the GW, Solman had won the game before it even started.

You only need three things to fix a bad situation: money, charm, and a loaded weapon.
4773:0.desc_zh:
炎热夏天的一天，在加勒比海上的郊外海岛，索尔曼正享受着一次奢华的短途度假旅行，这时，他被臭名昭著的游击队挟持为人质。索尔曼无意中偷听到这帮劫持者在讨论如何分赃，于是，他同这帮人协商达成一致，若能在24小时内再交付三名人质，那么他则可以重获自由。他做到了，他啥都没有借助，他唯一拥有的就只有金钱、魅力、以及如何跟世界上最可怕的邪教首领们沟通的技巧。游击队员们震惊于索尔曼那种对于同伴也毫无同情心的人格以及他能够提供稳定“赎金单位”（即“人质”）的能力，队员们为他在游击队中觅得了一个位置。索尔曼成为了游击队内获得人质赎金比例最高的人，这场游戏在开始之前就没有悬念了。

解决困局仅需三件东西：金钱、魅力和上膛的武器。

4774:0.name_en: Agent | Crasswater The Forgotten | Guerrilla Warfare
4774:0.name_zh: 探员 | 遗忘者克拉斯沃特 | 游击队
4774:0.desc_en:
Former Navy SEAL Capt. Crasswater was taken prisoner by the Guerrilla Warfare (GW) while serving in the Middle East during the 1990's. After a botched rescue attempt by ST6 and subsequent military cover-up, the US Navy declared Crasswater deceased. Over the years of his imprisonment, his patriotism and 'no man left behind' mantra eroded into bitter hatred for all things USA. Newly armed with a severe case of Stockholm Syndrome, Crasswater joined the Trappers of the GW. After a series of 'trust building' attacks on western embassies, Crasswater became GW's most valuable asset—bringing military discipline and organization to an otherwise chaotic gang of rebel fighters. In recent years Crasswater has grown new GW cells at undisclosed locations across Central America. 

Just one more forget-me-not.
4774:0.desc_zh:
克拉斯沃特，前海豹突击队员，于1990年在中东服役期间被游击队俘获。海豹突击队第六分队营救失败，随后，美国海军通过各种军事掩盖手段，最终宣布克拉斯沃特死亡。在多年的监禁生活之后，他的爱国情怀以及“不放弃不抛弃”的口号逐渐转变为对任何美国有关事物的仇恨。之后，克拉斯沃特患上了严重的斯德哥尔摩综合征，他选择加入游击队捕兽者行列。在参与了一系列针对西方使馆的以“建立信任”为目的的攻击之后，克拉斯沃特成为了游击队最宝贵的资产——为原本混乱不堪的叛军团伙带来了军事纪律和组织建设。近年来，克拉斯沃特在中美洲各地的秘密基地建立新的游击小队。

我是如此的难以忘记。

4775:0.name_en: Agent | Arno The Overgrown | Guerrilla Warfare
4775:0.name_zh: 探员 | 亚诺（野草） | 游击队
4775:0.desc_en:
Disgraced heavyweight boxing champion, Arno The Overgrown was discovered by Guerrilla Warfare (GW) Trappers living out of a cave. Over the years Arno had become an expert survivalist and big-game hunter—able to live off the land for an indefinite amount of time carrying only his flint stick and sharpened hunting knife. Rumors of Arno eventually spread to nearby townships where he came to attention of Guerrilla Warfare (GW). Wanting to recruit Arno's flawless hunting and fighting skills, the GW failed to coax Arno from his habitat, that is, until they threatened to stop visiting him with hot fresh Milk Tarts every month. 

It isn't the loneliness that kills you, it's the absence of Melk Tarts.
4775:0.desc_zh:
亚诺（野草），这位备受羞辱的重量级拳击冠军，被住在山洞外的游击队捕猎者们发现。多年来，亚诺已成为生存专家和大型游戏狩猎者——能够仅凭借一根燧石棒和一把锋利猎刀在野外无限期的生存下来。关于目击亚诺的谣言传到附近的小镇上，并成功吸引了游击队的注意。游击队希望招安亚诺，利用他完美的狩猎技巧和作战能力为组织服务，虽然游击队多次发现了他的踪迹，却未能成功诱使阿诺离开他的栖息地。最后，游击队只能威胁他不再每月来给他送来新鲜出炉的热奶油馅饼。

击杀你的不是孤独，而是奶油馅饼

4776:0.name_en: Agent | Col. Mangos Dabisi | Guerrilla Warfare
4776:0.name_zh: 探员 | 上校曼戈斯·达比西 | 游击队
4776:0.desc_en:
Early in his life Col. Mangos Dabisi was trained and promoted within Ugandan military. He ended his military career with a rare Dishonorable Discharge for intimidating his subordinates into paying him 'sleep well money'—promising a good night's sleep to those who paid him. Turns out, a good night's sleep was merely a lack of intentional injuries inflicted by Dabisi himself. Dabisi's imposing stature and military skill made him an attractive acquisition for the Guerrilla Warfare (GW). Constantly over-using force and needing to be reined in, Dabisi's reputation as a GW powerhouse is well deserved.

I chop your doller or your neck. You choose.
4776:0.desc_zh:
上校曼戈斯·达比西早年在乌干达军营里受训，并得到过晋升。他曾恐吓下属，威胁让他们支付“安睡费”——承诺给钱的人会睡个好觉，不付钱的则有罪受——所以最后，他以非常不光彩的退伍结束了自己的军事生涯。事实证明，能睡个安稳觉的原因是达比西不再故意折腾那些人。尽管如此，他令人敬畏的身材和军事素养使得他成为了游击队中一名非常有人气的“获取专家”。不断地过度使用暴力，并搭配上萝卜配大棒的拉扯方式，达比西成为了游击队中当之无愧的强力者。

砍哪儿，你说吧。

4777:0.name_en: Agent | Vypa Sista of the Revolution | Guerrilla Warfare
4777:0.name_zh: 探员 | 薇帕姐（革新派） | 游击队
4777:0.desc_en:
A notorious rebel and brilliant improviser, Vypa is one of twelve sisters born into poverty and left to fend for themselves at the age of seven. Vypa's solo attacks against her country's military dictatorship were so prolific the military assumed her work was the result of a small team of people. At one point, Vypa mistook a remote Guerrilla Warfare (GW) training ground for a government outpost. Shortly after invoking one of her infamous 'sting and choke' maneuvers on the camp she realized her mistake, but not before she had Capt. Crasswater tied up to a tree and threatened at knife point. Impressed and a little frightened, Crasswater recruited Vypa and her sisters into the GW. Together they now lead all jungle-based GW missions and 'government awareness' campaigns. 

Don't worry, it's just me.
4777:0.desc_zh:
声名狼藉的叛国者，杰出的即兴表演家。作为十二姐妹中的一个，她出生在一个穷苦的家庭之中，七岁时离家自谋生计。凭借机智灵巧和出色的生存能力，她对国家的独裁军事机构进行过数次的攻击，皆为单独作业，但是宪兵队却以为这些单独任务均出自于一小队人共同完成。有一次，薇帕把一个地处偏远的游击队训练营错当做政府的前哨战。在她对营地发起招牌式的“刺哽”攻击不久后，便意识到了错误停下了，不过，此时，克拉斯沃特已经被她钉在一棵树上，并架在刀尖上。克拉斯沃特虽然有些害怕，有些震撼，但他招安了薇帕和她的姐妹。现如今，他们一起领导、指挥游击队的所有丛林任务和“政府意识”活动。

就姐一人。

4778:0.name_zh: 探员 | 捕兽者（挑衅者） | 游击队
4778:0.desc_en:
The experienced and cunning Trapper Aggressors utilize ruthless efficiency in capturing and securing tourists as hostages. As experts in wetland and jungle-based guerrilla tactics, any rescue missions involving Trapper Aggressors are doomed to fail. 

The promise of air conditioning and iced tea. It works every time.
4778:0.desc_zh:
经验丰富且狡猾的捕兽者（挑衅者），面对抓捕对象的时候简直无情，可以高效而快速地捕获目标，基本在对方还没反应的情况下已将其变为盘中之物。作为湿地和丛林游击战术的专家的捕兽者（挑衅者），任何救援任务在他面前都显得幼稚可笑且又不堪一击。

冷气和冰红茶，没人能讨厌。

4780:0.name_zh: 探员 | 克拉斯沃特（三分熟） | 游击队
4780:0.desc_en:
Former Navy SEAL Capt. Crasswater was taken prisoner by the Guerrilla Warfare (GW) while serving in the Middle East during the 1990's. After a botched rescue attempt by ST6 and subsequent military cover-up, the US Navy declared Crasswater deceased. Over the years of his imprisonment, his patriotism and 'no man left behind' mantra eroded into bitter hatred for all things USA. After a series of 'trust building' attacks on western embassies, Crasswater became GW's most valuable asset—bringing military discipline and organization to an otherwise chaotic gang of rebel fighters. 4781:0.name_zh: 探员 | 捕兽者 | 游击队
4781:0.desc_en:
Sharp, stealthy, and the bane of organised military units everywhere, the Trappers are rarely seen before they are felt.  

We hunt you.
4781:0.desc_zh:
捕兽者很内行且隐蔽型强，是各地有组织军队的灾星，他们很少在有人查觉前被识破。 

你是我们的猎物。

48:0.desc_en: When thrown, the incendiary grenade releases a high-temperature chemical reaction capable of burning anyone within its wide blast radius.
48:0.desc_zh: 掷出后，燃烧弹即释放出高温化学反应物，可烧伤较大范围内的任何人。

49:0.desc_en: Stable and resistant to most physical shocks, this improvised plastic explosive has a detonation velocity of over 8,000 meters per second when ignited.
49:0.desc_zh: 稳定耐用，能够承受绝大部分的物理冲击，这个简陋的塑胶炸药在引爆时能制造速度超过每秒 8,000 米的冲击波。

500:0.desc_en: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan.
500:0.desc_zh: 其设计相对于第二次世界大战以来基本没有变化，刺刀在现代军事战略中仍占有一席之地。在最近的第二次海湾战争和阿富汗战争中也榜上有名。

500:12.desc_en:
It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread
500:12.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色为外表，使用蜘蛛网图案的花纹进行了涂装，完毕后再配上了半光的表层。

留意你的脚步，你永远都不会知道蛛网撒在何处

500:143.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application
500:143.desc_zh:
这把武器以交杂在一起的胶带为漏字板进行了喷漆。

真正的力量总是用精细的应用加以证明

500:175.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary
500:175.desc_zh:
这把武器被漆上了阳光斑驳图案。

“凤凰”不是毁灭的象征… 恰恰相反，它象征着重生 - 革命者瓦莱里娅.琴纳

500:38.desc_en:
It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training
500:38.desc_zh:
这把武器以铬为外表，使用喷笔涂上了相互渐变的透明涂装。

这不仅仅是一把武器，更是一种潮流 - 实习军火商伊莫金

500:40.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck
500:40.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以黑夜行动的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

疑是清风，却是封喉…

500:409.desc_en:
It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...
500:409.desc_zh:
这把武器配上虎纹图案进行了橙黄电镀处理和手工蚀刻。

如虎般珍稀… 如虎般致命…

500:410.desc_en:
It has been forged from a billet made from two different types of carbon steel.

Finally, a weapon strong enough to match your resolve
500:410.desc_zh:
基于两种不同类型的碳钢合铸的子弹，煅造出了这件武器。

终于，有这么一件无坚不摧的利器能与你无坚不摧的意志相得益彰

500:413.desc_en:
It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red
500:413.desc_zh:
这把武器使用黑色和银色的金属涂料画上的仿大理石纹进行了涂装，并且外表裹上了三层颜色的糖衣。

刺刀见虹，刺刀见红

500:414.desc_en:
It is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Some people don't need to hide how dirty their deeds are
500:414.desc_zh:
这把武器可以用一句话来形容：“败絮其外，金玉其中”。

使用这把武器的人再也无法掩饰自己犯下的滔天罪行了

500:415.desc_en:
It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal
500:415.desc_zh:
这把武器使用黑色和银色的金属涂料画上的仿大理石纹进行了涂装，并且外表裹上了糖衣。

被其外表所迷惑后果会很严重

被其外表所迷惑后果会很严重

500:419.desc_en:
It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

5033:10024.desc_en:
This is the original classic black design that made Tortue a household name.

Don't call it a midlife crisis

这是让托尔蒂成为家喻户晓的名字的原始经典黑色设计。

对于他给我们开出的价钱，你会觉得赫胥黎会至少抛出额外的一小笔…… - 指挥官费利克斯.莱利r

This pair has been covered in comic book onomatopoeia.

POW! BOOM! BIFF!

乓！嘣！哐！

This pair of black gloves has been accented with a stark red diamond pattern.

Start seeing red

这副黑色手套配上了鲜红色的菱形图案。

开始见红

The back of the gloves have been given a spiderweb pattern.

Discipline begets success

这副手套的背部附上了蜘蛛网的图案。

纪律铸就成功

5034:10035.desc_en:
The white and black gloves have been given orange accents

Rumor has it that Tortue was inspired by the Asiimov line of firearms
5034:10035.desc_zh:
这副白黑相间的手套附上了橙色色调。

有谣言称托尔蒂是受到二西莫夫火器线的启发

5034:10062.desc_zh: 这副手套的实用之处在于，野外狩猎的时候拥有绝佳的隐身效果。

505:0.desc_en: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable.

It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

基于两种不同类型的碳钢合铸的子弹，煅造出了这件武器。

终于，有这么一件无坚不摧的利器能与你无坚不摧的意志相得益彰

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

这把武器配上斑纹图案，使用铝和拥有不同反射率的铬涂料进行了涂装，然后覆上了番茄红色的糖衣。

瓦莱里娅不是雇哈维来提出问题的… 而是雇他来探出答案的

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

基于两种不同类型的碳钢合铸的子弹，煅造出了这件武器。

508:413.desc_en:
It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

这把武器使用黑色和银色的金属涂料画上的仿大理石纹进行了涂装，并且外表裹上了三层颜色的糖衣。

Some people don't need to hide how dirty their deeds are

508:59.desc_en:

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

这把武器配上斑纹图案，使用铝和拥有不同反射率的铬涂料进行了涂装，然后覆上了番茄红色的糖衣。

瓦莱里娅不是雇哈维来提出问题的… 而是雇他来探出答案的

508:72.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment
508:72.desc_zh:
这把武器以围住的网格和纸板切口为漏字板进行了喷漆。

不管环境怎么变，弱肉强食的法则永远不会改变

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

森林也许会是危险之地…… 不宜一人独往

509:0.desc_en: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

True power is demonstrated with subtle application
509:143.desc_zh:

真正的力量总是用精细的应用加以证明

5105:0.desc_en:
An expert in local knowledge for Elite Crew's urban operations, Ground Rebels are known for keeping an ear to the ground.

That's the signal.

那就是信号。

5106:0.name_zh: 探员 | 奥西瑞斯 | 精锐分子
5106:0.desc_en:
Osiris earned his nickname from passing judgement, often too quickly, on his marks. His reasoning is simple: "When your time is as valuable as mine, why make small talk?" 

Confident, skilled, and quick to act, Osiris takes pleasure in dispatching targets with unrivaled efficiency.

Any objections?
5106:0.desc_zh:
奥西瑞斯具有极强的判断力，从而得到了外号。他常常能做到一语中的， 道理很简单，他说道：“当你的时间和我一样珍贵时，干嘛还要闲聊？”

由于奥西瑞斯的自信，技术精湛以及反应灵敏，他总是能以超高效率击杀目标，对此他乐在其中。

有反对意见吗？

5107:0.name_zh: 探员 | 沙哈马特教授 | 精锐分子
5107:0.desc_en:
After graduating Magna Cum Laude, Prof. Shahmat began teaching to impart knowledge. With every class Shahmat realized his pupils didn't have the same revolutionary desires that he did. 

Recognizing that his mind was beginning to dull, he decided to seek a new challenge—mastering the art of war.

Watch and learn.
5107:0.desc_zh:
以优异学业成绩毕业后，沙哈马特教授开始当老师。每节课上，沙哈马特发现他的学生没有像他一样的变革渴望。

他意识到自己的思想正在渐渐麻木，便决定寻求新的挑战，那就是成为战争艺术的主宰。

好好学着点。

5108:0.name_en: Agent | The Elite Mr. Muhlik | Elite Crew
5108:0.name_zh: 探员 | 精英穆哈里克先生 | 精锐分子
5108:0.desc_en:
First appeared operating as an 'Acquisitions Consultant' for arms industry magnates, Mr. Muhlik quickly worked his way on to many Most Wanted lists worldwide. Unconfirmed reports suggest he is the last surviving heir to a recently-deposed Middle Eastern monarch. 

With evidence of elite military training, international private education, and numerous international bank accounts, it's suspected Mr. Muhlik is maneuvering to rebuild sovereign power over his family's historical lands.

Pressure and time.
5108:0.desc_zh:
关于这个臭名昭著的中东精锐分子首领，只有一小部分可靠信息。

首先，作为一名军备企业巨头的收购顾问，穆哈里克先生凭借其自身努力，成功跻身全球十大通缉犯的行列。据未经证实的报道称，他的真正身份是最近才被罢免的中东统治者最后幸存继承人。
\穆哈里克先生曾参加过精英军事训练，接受过国际私立学校教育，并拥有多个国际银行账户，根据以上证据推测，穆哈里克先生正在调兵遣将，以此在其家族所在地重建主权。

压力和时间。

It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

518:44.desc_en:
It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

通过木炭在高温下的应用，这把武器已被彩色表面淬火。

一点彩色痕迹无伤大雅

518:5.name_zh: 求生匕首 | 森林 DDPAT
518:5.desc_en:
It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late
518:5.desc_zh:
这把武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

当你能注意到像素图案的时候，已经为时已晚了

518:59.desc_en:
It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers
518:59.desc_zh:
这把武器配上斑纹图案，使用铝和拥有不同反射率的铬涂料进行了涂装，然后覆上了番茄红色的糖衣。

瓦莱里娅不是雇哈维来提出问题的… 而是雇他来探出答案的

518:72.name_zh: 求生匕首 | 狩猎网格
518:72.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment
518:72.desc_zh:
这把武器以围住的网格和纸板切口为漏字板进行了喷漆。

不管环境怎么变，弱肉强食的法则永远不会改变

518:735.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

这把武器以黑夜配色的纸带图案进行了喷漆。

喷绘... 渲染... 上色... 刺杀。

518:77.desc_en:
It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone
518:77.desc_zh:
这把武器使用森林迷彩花纹进行了涂装。

森林也许会是危险之地…… 不宜一人独往

518:98.name_zh: 求生匕首 | 致命紫罗兰
518:98.desc_en:
It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent
518:98.desc_zh:
这把武器的部分零件以黑色和紫色的配色方案进行了整体喷漆。

高贵的图案下暗藏着残忍卑鄙的阴谋

519:0.desc_en: This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work.
519:0.desc_zh: 这把日式短刀风格的求生刀具拥有多面刀刃和带握点的全刀柄。没有任何多余的部分 - 一把时刻准备战斗的可靠武器。

519:12.desc_en:
It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread
519:12.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色为外表，使用蜘蛛网图案的花纹进行了涂装，完毕后再配上了半光的表层。

留意你的脚步，你永远都不会知道蛛网撒在何处

519:143.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application
519:143.desc_zh:
这把武器以交杂在一起的胶带为漏字板进行了喷漆。

真正的力量总是用精细的应用加以证明

It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

519:414.desc_en:
It is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

It has been forged from a billet made from two different types of carbon steel.

Finally, a weapon strong enough to match your resolve

终于，有这么一件无坚不摧的利器能与你无坚不摧的意志相得益彰

It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

高贵的图案下暗藏着残忍卑鄙的阴谋

5205:0.name_zh: 探员 | 枪手 | 凤凰战士
5205:0.desc_en:
A capable shooter recruited by Phoenix to assist with Territory Reclamation Campaigns. Soldiers are extremely deadly alone, and even more so in numbers.

When do we shoot?
5205:0.desc_zh:
一名有能力的射手，他受雇于凤凰网络，协助领土收复战。士兵们在单兵作战时已经及其致命，更比说群起而攻之的时候了。

何时可以射击？

5206:0.name_zh: 探员 | 执行者 | 凤凰战士
5206:0.desc_en:
A multidisciplinary contract hitman for the Phoenix Connexion. Enforcers don't take all assignments, just the ones they find interesting.

Time is money.
5206:0.desc_zh:
一名受雇于凤凰商号的多面刺客。执行者们不会接下所有任务，而只会接他们感兴趣的任务。

时间就是金钱。

5207:0.name_zh: 探员 | 弹弓 | 凤凰战士
5207:0.desc_en:
Slingshot is a critical component of Phoenix Connexion's dominance in close-range combat.

Tightly wound and capable of devastating results with little resources, Slingshot earned his nickname after retaking the Phoenix compound with only an M9 Bayonet and recovered weapons.

If I can knife, I knife.
5207:0.desc_zh:
“弹弓”是凤凰商号部署近距离作战的重要成员。

死死缠绕对手的他，有能力在资源紧缺的情况下对敌人造成毁灭性的打击。在仅靠一把M9刺刀以及敌人武器的情况下，“弹弓”重新夺回凤凰工业基地，由此他获得了这个外号。

只要我还有一口气，就会战斗到底。

5208:0.name_zh: 探员 | 街头士兵 | 凤凰战士
5208:0.desc_en:
A Phoenix ground force gang with expertise in high density urban environments. Their knowledge of back roads and alleyways are only surpassed by local taxi drivers, which are rumored to make up a significant portion of their numbers.

I know a shortcut.
5208:0.desc_zh:
他们是凤凰组织的地面力量，对楼房林立的都市环境了若指掌。他们对于偏僻道路或小街小巷的了解可能只有当地出租车司机才能比肩，然而据说，出租车司机也是帮派成员，而且占比也不小。

我知道一条捷径。

521:0.desc_en: This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material.
521:0.desc_zh: 这把符合人体工程学的战术狩猎匕首，内嵌复合握把以及坚固宽刃，可用于切割或撬开材料。

521:12.name_zh: 流浪者匕首 | 深红之网
521:12.desc_en:
It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread
521:12.desc_zh:
这把武器以红色为外表，使用蜘蛛网图案的花纹进行了涂装，完毕后再配上了半光的表层。

留意你的脚步，你永远都不会知道蛛网撒在何处

521:143.name_zh: 流浪者匕首 | 都市伪装
521:143.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application
521:143.desc_zh:
这把武器以交杂在一起的胶带为漏字板进行了喷漆。

真正的力量总是用精细的应用加以证明

521:175.name_zh: 流浪者匕首 | 枯焦之色
521:175.desc_en:

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

“凤凰”不是毁灭的象征… 恰恰相反，它象征着重生 - 革命者瓦莱里娅.琴纳

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

刺刀见虹，刺刀见红

Some people don't need to hide how dirty their deeds are

使用这把武器的人再也无法掩饰自己犯下的滔天罪行了

你也许以为刀刃上一团糟，请在黑光灯源下瞧瞧吧

526:44.name_zh: 廓尔喀刀 | 表面淬火
526:44.desc_en:
It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone
526:44.desc_zh:
通过木炭在高温下的应用，这把武器已被彩色表面淬火。

一点彩色痕迹无伤大雅

526:5.name_zh: 廓尔喀刀 | 森林 DDPAT
526:5.desc_en:
It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late
526:5.desc_zh:
这把武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

当你能注意到像素图案的时候，已经为时已晚了

526:59.desc_en:
It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers
526:59.desc_zh:
这把武器配上斑纹图案，使用铝和拥有不同反射率的铬涂料进行了涂装，然后覆上了番茄红色的糖衣。

瓦莱里娅不是雇哈维来提出问题的… 而是雇他来探出答案的

526:72.name_zh: 廓尔喀刀 | 狩猎网格
526:72.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment
526:72.desc_zh:
这把武器以围住的网格和纸板切口为漏字板进行了喷漆。

不管环境怎么变，弱肉强食的法则永远不会改变

526:735.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.
526:735.desc_zh:
这把武器以黑夜配色的纸带图案进行了喷漆。

喷绘... 渲染... 上色... 刺杀。

526:77.name_zh: 廓尔喀刀 | 北方森林
526:77.desc_en:
It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone
526:77.desc_zh:
这把武器使用森林迷彩花纹进行了涂装。

森林也许会是危险之地…… 不宜一人独往

5305:0.name_zh: 探员 | 特种兵 | 联邦调查局（FBI）特警
5305:0.desc_en:
Members of the FBI's SWAT team are deployed in high-risk situations. Counterterrorism, hostage rescue, and bomb defusals are a few of the many disciplines FBI SWAT agents specialize in.

Fidelity, Bravery, Integrity.
5305:0.desc_zh:
联邦调查局特警部队的成员，已分布在高危环境下。反恐，人质营救以及拆弹都是联邦调查局特警探员的专长。

尽职，勇敢，正直。

5306:0.name_zh: 探员 | 马尔库斯·戴劳 | 联邦调查局（FBI）人质营救队
5306:0.desc_en:
There's no detail too small for Markus Delrow. Equipment, battle plans, oppositional tactics—you name it—and he's already thought of it twice. 

Being two steps ahead is what he does best, and Delrow takes pride in being the brains of the operation.

All that's left is to execute.
5306:0.desc_zh:
马尔库斯·戴劳是个心思缜密的人。装备，战斗计划，对敌战术，只要你能想到的，他会比你多考虑两步。

戴劳最擅长的就是占尽先机，所以他很自豪能成为行动的智商担当。

剩下的，去执行就是了。

5307:0.name_zh: 探员 | 迈克·赛弗斯 | 联邦调查局（FBI）狙击手
5307:0.desc_en:
An ex-Division I athlete, Syfers was recruited by the FBI after a catastrophic knee injury ended his sports career early. Yet even in adversity he remained positive. 

It's rare to find someone whose desire to succeed is matched by their desire to do good, but Syfers checks both boxes.

Naturally, I finished my reps.
5307:0.desc_zh:
作为前国家一级运动员，Syfers在他膝盖受伤并结束运动生涯后，曾受雇于联邦调查局。然而即便在逆境中，他仍旧保持乐观的态度。

通常，人们对于总是渴望通过做善事收获成功，而Syfers却渴望黑白两道通吃。

很显然，这就是无间道。

5308:0.name_zh: 探员 | 爱娃特工 | 联邦调查局（FBI）
5308:0.desc_en:
Initially underestimated, Special Agent Ava soon became her team's ultimate secret weapon. 

Despite receiving three out of five possible FBI Honorary Medals, Ava is surprisingly indifferent to her accomplishments. The way she sees it, it's nothing compared to growing up with four older brothers in urban New Jersey. 

Special Agent Ava takes pleasure from the simple things: clean wins, cold beer, and turning bad guys into thin crust pizza pie. 

They see me. They're confused. And then they're dead.
5308:0.desc_zh:
一开始，爱娃特工被局里低估。不过没过多久，她就成为了团队里的终极秘密武器。

尽管爱娃曾获得3块美国联邦调查局（FBI）荣誉奖章，不过她对自己荣获的成就毫不在意。在她看来，这些荣誉都无法和自己在新泽西城里一起长大的4个哥哥相提并论。

爱娃特工是个知足常乐的人，无论是干净利落拿下犯人，还是让坏蛋毫无还手之力，甚至是一杯冰啤酒都能让她乐开怀。

他们看见我就晕，晕了就歇菜。

5400:0.name_zh: 探员 | 第三特种兵连 | 德国特种部队突击队
5400:0.desc_en:
An elite soldier from Germany's Kommando Spezialkräfte, members of 3rd Commando Company are hand-picked to be part of KSK's Operational Forces.

This is not relevant to the task at hand.
5400:0.desc_zh:
一名来自德国特种部队司令部的精英士兵，第三特种兵连的成员都是精挑细选出来的，才能成为德国特种部队突击队的作战部队成员。

这与手头任务无关。

5401:0.name_en: Agent | Seal Team 6 Soldier | NSWC SEAL
5401:0.name_zh: 探员 | 海豹突击队第六分队士兵 | 海军水面战中心海豹部队
5401:0.desc_en:
Combat-ready and hungry for wins, SEAL Team 6 soldiers know how to get the job done.

I'm just happy to be here.
5401:0.desc_zh:
整装待发，渴望胜利。海豹突击队第六分队的士兵们知道如何行事。

我只是很高兴出现在这里。

5402:0.name_zh: 探员 | 铅弹 | 海军水面战中心海豹部队
5402:0.desc_en:
Known as SEAL Team's "Weapons Sommelier" Buckshot has thoroughly field-tested and reviewed almost every available military weapon in staggering depth. ST6 relies on Buckshot's knowledge of lesser-known guns for edge case advantages in ground based operations—but in the interest of time, they strenuously avoid casual conversation on the topic.

They talk to me. The guns. They have feelings.
5402:0.desc_zh:
铅弹已经全面而细致地实地评测过几乎所有可用的军事武器。海豹突击队第六分队依靠其在小众枪支领域中的知识，在地面作战行动中取得了优势——但为了节省时间，他们极力避免随意谈论这个话题。

枪是有灵性的，能与我沟通。

5403:0.name_zh: 探员 | “两次”麦考伊 | 美国空军战术空中管制部队
5403:0.desc_en:
'Two Times' McCoy earned his nickname by completing TACP's field training twice. Official records mark this up to a scheduling mix-up, but his teammates report restraining him from completing the trifecta.

With inhuman reserves of physical and mental stamina, McCoy often finds himself the last person standing at the end of any conflict—physical and verbal alike. 

Yep. Still here.
5403:0.desc_zh:
在海豹部队完成两次臭名昭著的地狱周末训练后，麦考伊被人取了个外号。不太确定是出于安排上的混乱，还是说他享受这个过程。

总之，麦考伊拥有超出常人的体力和意志力。他常常发现，自己就是那个总能在各种打斗中坚持到最后一刻的人。

没错，他还在。

5404:0.name_en: Agent | Lt. Commander Ricksaw | NSWC SEAL
5404:0.name_zh: 探员 | 海军上尉里克索尔 | 海军水面战中心海豹部队
5404:0.desc_en:
Lt. Commander Ricksaw's comically laissez-faire attitude toward heavy combat keeps his SEAL team calm and deadly in the most dire situations. 

Having lead more special ops than any other SEAL to date, Ricksaw knows life is short, and encourages his team to make the most of the time they have—including cheerfully serving up bullets and frag grenades to high- value targets at any and all occasions.

Hotdogs, hellcats and hand grenades. Hooya!
5404:0.desc_zh:
海军上尉里克索尔对高强度战斗采取放任自由的可笑态度，这让他的海豹部队即使在最严峻的形势下，都能沉着冷静，招招致命。

海军上尉里克索尔知道人生苦短，可相比其他海豹部队的成员，至今为止他带队完成过的特殊任务最多。他鼓励队员们趁还活着尽情享受人生，而对里克索尔来说，在对高分目标的无情打击中欢度了他的美好时光。

关门放狗，悍将出动，手雷伺候。好极了！

5405:0.name_zh: 探员 | 陆军中尉普里米罗 | 巴西第一营
5405:0.desc_en:
As a combat survival specialist in deep jungle operations, the Brazilian 1st Battalion sharpen their teeth alongside the banks of the mighty Amazon River.   

Surprises welcome.
5405:0.desc_zh:
作为深入丛林行动的战斗生存专家，巴西第一营在浩瀚的亚马逊河岸边磨砺他们的技术。   

惊喜驾到。

5500:0.name_zh: 探员 | 德拉戈米尔 | 军刀
5500:0.desc_en:
A man of few words, Dragomir is disturbingly patient. Known for holding position for days at a time, some say he's one of Sabre's best marksman. Others say he's napping. No one really knows. No one left alive, anyway.

...I wait.
5500:0.desc_zh:
作为一个少言寡语的人，德拉戈米尔相当有耐心。他可以一次连着好几天坚守岗位，有人说他是军刀组织里最好的射手。其他人说，他是在打盹。没有人知道实情。因为没有人能获得离开。

……我等着。

5501:0.name_zh: 探员 | 马克西姆斯 | 军刀
5501:0.desc_en:
Motivated by a simmering inner rage and a lifelong obsession with vengeance for transgressions large, small, and seemingly insignificant, Maximus is Sabre's first choice for close quarter mission support. No grudge is too small to be repaid in blood.

No, YOU overreacted.
5501:0.desc_zh:
受到即将爆发的怒意以及复仇任务的刺激，马克西姆斯是军刀组织首选的近距离任务支援力量。血债血偿才是王道

不要啊，冲动是魔鬼。

5502:0.name_zh: 探员 | 准备就绪的列赞 | 军刀
5502:0.desc_en:
An expert grenadier and the once-celebrated author of The Joy of Preparedness, Rezan The Ready is Sabre's self-appointed Head of Operations.

His fiery temper when things get out of hand has earned him the alternative nickname Rezan the Red—but never to his face.

I take great pride in my work.
5502:0.desc_zh:
作为一名专业掷弹兵，列赞是军刀组织任命的行动领袖。

当事情脱离列赞掌控时，他的暴脾气就显露无疑，其他人给他取了一个外号，“涨红了脸”的列赞。绝对不要当面喊他这个外号。

我骄傲，我自豪。

5503:0.name_zh: 探员 | 黑狼 | 军刀
5503:0.desc_en:
Blackwolf stalks Sabre's enemies with preternatural determination and focus. Raised deep within the bitter forests of Eastern Europe, he can sense human presence with exceptional accuracy—and he knows what to do when he's sensed it. 

I don't need to see them to kill them.
5503:0.desc_zh:
黑狼能集中注意力，精确跟踪军刀组织的敌人。由于生长在条件艰苦的东欧森林深处， 他能精确感知到人类的存在。

我都不需要看，就能杀了他们。

5504:0.name_zh: 探员 | “医生”罗曼诺夫 | 军刀
5504:0.desc_en:
After expertly smuggling pharmaceuticals across disputed borders for over 30 years, the 'doctor' now leads Sabre's Utility Disruption Operations. Rumoured to be responsible for the synchronized destruction of several UN power facilities, Romanov is known by his enemies to be calculating, deliberate, and frighteningly precise. Of course, his mother says he's just mixed up with the wrong crowd.

It's simple. We make a plan and the plan is to win.
5504:0.desc_zh:
这名“医生”拥有超过30年以上穿越争端地带进行专业贩卖非法药物的经历，现在他带队加入到了军刀组织领土收复战中。有传闻说，他还负责同步摧毁多个UN设施。罗曼诺夫被他的敌人所熟知，处于他的精于算计以及深思熟虑。他母亲说，他常年混迹于不法之徒间，才近墨者黑了。

很简单，我们制定个计划，就是要赢。

5505:0.name_zh: 探员 | 德拉戈米尔 | 军刀勇士
5505:0.desc_en:
Sabre has noticed that enemies seem to die quite frequently around Dragomir, even though they've never actually seen him shoot his gun. They're happy to keep him around... for now. 

...I wait.
5505:0.desc_zh:
虽然没人见过他开枪，但军刀这边发现他们的敌人似乎总倒在德拉戈米尔的身边，军刀很乐意把他留在身边...至少暂时是这样的。

...我等！

5601:0.name_zh: 探员 | B 中队指挥官 | 英国空军特别部队
5601:0.desc_en:
Highly classified and incredibly lethal, Officers in the SAS spend years sharpening their skills through infiltration, hostage rescue, and —REDACTED— missions not fit for the public eye.

Who dares, wins.
5601:0.desc_zh:
英国空军特别部队的军官，他们的存在属于高度机密，花费数年时间磨练技能的他们，通过打入敌方内部，人质营救以及不被外人所知的隐秘任务，变得极具杀伤力。

谁敢来试试，赢给你看。

5602:0.name_zh: 探员 | D 中队军官 | 新西兰特种空勤团
5602:0.desc_en:
Highly classified and incredibly lethal, Officers in the SAS spend years sharpening their skills through infiltration, hostage rescue, and —REDACTED— missions not fit for the public eye.

Who dares, wins.
5602:0.desc_zh:
特种空勤团的军官，他们的存在属于高度机密，花费数年时间磨练技能的他们，通过打入敌方内部，人质营救以及不被外人所知的隐秘任务，变得极具杀伤力。

勇者胜！

59:0.desc_en: Quiet and always available, the knife has a fast, low-damage primary attack and a slow, high-damage secondary attack. A backstab will earn quiet players an instant kill.
59:0.desc_zh: 杀人于悄无声息之中，且永远可用，匕首拥有快速、低伤害的主要攻击和较慢、高伤害的次要攻击。背刺能使玩家在悄然无声之中对敌人造成“秒杀”。

60:0.desc_en: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy.
60:0.desc_zh: 消音版 M4A1 相对于它那没有消音器的同行来说弹匣更小，枪声也较为“沉默”，还拥有更小的后坐力和更高的精准度。

60:1001.name_zh: M4A1消音版 | 冒险家乐园
60:1001.desc_en:
This custom paint job features ancient iconography and a golden pit viper before a dusk-tinted jungle background.

Strike without warning
60:1001.desc_zh:
这把武器使的亮点在于仿旧的图案花纹，在风景如画的背景丛林里隐藏着一条黄金毒蟒。

快速出击！

60:1017.desc_en:
Multiple layers of metallic blue paint have been applied over a chrome blue base coat.

Feeling blue?
60:1017.desc_zh:
这把武器采用多层金属质感的蓝色喷涂，表面另附上铬涂层处理。

闷闷不乐吗？

60:1059.desc_en:
A tan and red retro techno-inspired pattern has been applied.

Wars are won with information
60:1059.desc_zh:
这把武器绘有棕褐色和红色的复古技术灵感图案

打仗要靠情报取胜

60:106.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a Greco-Roman statue and other distorted imagery from a bygone era.

From a hypnagogic dream
60:106.desc_zh:
这款定制涂装描绘了古希腊-罗马雕像以及来自旧时代的其他扭曲图像。

源自半梦半醒的幻境

60:1073.desc_en:
A custom paint job of multicolored safety signs has been applied.

Don't say I didn't warn you… - Booth, Arms Dealer
60:1073.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了多色安全标志的自定义涂装。

别说我没提醒你……- 军火商布兹

60:1130.desc_en:
Scattered thoughts from the mind of an insomniac have been scrawled across this custom-painted A1-S.

In the bosom of the gentle night, is when I search for the light
60:1130.desc_zh:
这把 A1-S 的自定义涂装描绘了一位失眠者脑海中的零星想法。

在柔和夜色的笼罩下，正是我寻找光明的时候

60:1166.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a black lotus flower over a blue and purple base.

Adds 2 kills during rifle round, then is discarded
60:1166.desc_zh:
这把武器在蓝色和紫色的基底上绘制了一朵黑色的莲花图案。

在步枪回合中增加2次击杀，然后被弃用

60:1177.desc_en:
It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training
60:1177.desc_zh:
这把武器以铬为外表，使用喷笔涂上了相互渐变的透明涂装。

这不仅仅是一把武器，更是一种潮流 - 实习军火商伊莫金

60:1216.name_zh: M4A1消音版 | 平流层巡航
60:1216.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with spacefaring ships circling a planet in outer space.

"One day in the not too distant future..."
60:1216.desc_zh:
它采用了宇宙飞船环行星涂装。

“在不远的未来某日……”

60:1223.name_zh: M4A1消音版 | 隐伏帝王龙
60:1223.desc_en:
It has been custom painted to look like a dinosaur is clawing through the side of the weapon.

Feeding frenzy
60:1223.desc_zh:
这把武器使用像一只恐龙从武器的一面撕裂到另一面的图案进行了自定义涂装。

疯狂撕咬

60:1243.desc_en:
A custom black and brown camouflage has been applied.

Backup has arrived
60:1243.desc_zh:
这把武器使用黑棕迷彩进行了自定义涂装。

援军已至

60:1311.desc_en:
A multicolored abstract paint pattern has been applied.

Please return to display after use
60:1311.desc_zh:
枪身采用了抽象多色泼溅涂装。

使用后请放回展台

60:1319.desc_en:
A hydrographic hex pattern has been applied.

Hex marks the spot
60:1319.desc_zh:
枪身采用了水转印六边形蜂巢涂装。

六边形战士在此

60:1338.desc_en:
A mountain terrain pattern has been applied.

Being alone is a privilege, not a burden
60:1338.desc_zh:
它采用了山脉地形涂装。

独处是特权，而非负担

60:1340.desc_en:
Its dark base and carefully selected red and blue highlights make this custom painted M4A1-S appear as if it's glowing under ambient light.

Quiet reflection
60:1340.desc_zh:
深色基底与精挑细选的红蓝撞色点缀，使这把M4A1消音版的定制涂装在环境光下宛若发光。

寂静沉思

60:1376.desc_en:
A bright, neon-colored animal print pattern has been applied.

You said "a few colors", not "the entire color spectrum"
60:1376.desc_zh:
采用了明亮霓虹色的动物纹涂装。

你说要“几种颜色”，不是“整个光谱”

60:1433.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a marbled green base and finished with gold and red accents.

They don't pay you enough to carry that, but I will - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary
60:1433.desc_zh:
它定制涂装了绿色大理石底色，并以金色和红色点缀收尾。

他们给的薪水配不上这把枪，但我会给你足够的报酬 – 革命者瓦莱里娅.琴纳

60:1476.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using bright green pearlescent paint.

When keeping a low profile isn't an option
60:1476.desc_zh:
它采用亮绿色珠光漆进行了定制涂装。

当低调不再是一种选择

60:160.desc_en:
A tan, purple, and gold hydrographic graffiti pattern has been applied.

Nothing a little elbow grease can't fix

这把武器以金属为外表，使用雷击图案，通过阳极化处理进行了涂装。

你可以像雷霆那样一击毙命

9:525.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using a combination of hydrographics and careful stenciling and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

Chase Turner was a great man... you have big shoes to fill – The Phoenix and The Initiate, Part 1
9:525.desc_zh:
这把武器将花纹和严谨的漏印结合起来，通过热转印贴花加强细节，然后进行了自定义涂装。

蔡斯.特纳曾是个伟大的男人… 你现在可是背负着他那重大的使命啊 –《凤凰与崛起（上）》

9:584.desc_en:
It is constructed of metal panels and durable electronic components.

Build a better world
9:584.desc_zh:
这件武器由金属板与耐用电子元件制成。

建立一个更美好的世界

9:640.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with pink, blue, and purple drawings atop a black base.

Delirium is a dangerous thing
9:640.desc_zh:
这把武器在纯黑的底色上使用了粉色、蓝色、以及紫色的定绘。

谵妄为危。

9:662.desc_en:
It has been hand painted with colorful samurai and Oni imagery.

Face your demons
9:662.desc_zh:
运用了多彩的日本武士与鬼的手绘。

面对你内心的邪恶

9:691.desc_en:
It has been custom painted using the Death tarot card as inspiration.

Every end is a new beginning
9:691.desc_zh:
这把武器的定制灵感来源于塔罗牌中的死神。

结束即开始

9:718.desc_en:
A pattern of felines, K-9s, and a creature with a red scarf has been applied.

Kill rewards paid in scratching posts and tennis balls
9:718.desc_zh:
涂装为猫咪、狗狗和一只戴着红面纱的不明生物。

杀掉对面就给你球球和猫抓板哦~

9:72.desc_en:
It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment
9:72.desc_zh:
这把武器以围住的网格和纸板切口为漏字板进行了喷漆。

不管环境怎么变，弱肉强食的法则永远不会改变

9:736.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with a red base and gold filigree.

Peace be with thee
9:736.desc_zh:
红色枪身上印有金丝拉花。

愿和平与你同在

9:756.desc_en:
Odin's spear travels down this custom painted pearlescent blue and ivory AWP.

A weapon for the Allfather
9:756.desc_zh:
奥丁的长矛附身到这把珠光宝气，通体天蓝的象牙制AWP上。

众神之父的武器

9:788.desc_en:
A multicolored hydrographic pattern has been applied.

A weapon of woe
9:788.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了多色水文图案。

惹麻烦的武器

9:803.desc_en:
It has been custom painted with two stylized blue-magenta women over a grayscale background.

"They took comfort in each other's despair"
9:803.desc_zh:
这把武器采用了灰度背景辅以蓝色和洋红色进行了自定义涂装，描绘了两位具有独特韵味的女子。

“两人在绝望中相互安慰”

9:819.desc_en:
Gold snakes creep towards the barrel of this custom painted AWP. The scope, barrel, and butt stock have been painted white.

Cutting off one head means two more appear—is that a risk you're willing to take? - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary
9:819.desc_zh:
这把AWP采用了自定义涂装，枪管上绘有金色的蛇图案。瞄准镜、枪管和枪托都涂成了白色。

一颗头要是被斩断，立刻又会生出两颗头来。这是你愿意承担的风险吗？ - 革命者瓦莱里娅·琴纳

9:838.desc_en:
A striking green and blue bush viper has been hand painted over a black base.

As deadly as it is beautiful
9:838.desc_zh:
黑色案底上手绘了一条富有冲击力的蓝色树蝰.

危险的事固然美丽

9:84.desc_en:
It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late
9:84.desc_zh:
这把武器使用数字迷彩（DDPAT）图案的花纹进行了涂装。

当你能注意到像素图案的时候，已经为时已晚了

9:887.desc_en:
It has been custom painted to depict mutated rats trying to escape a radioactive, neon green forest.

Who knows what radioactive diseases they carry…
9:887.desc_zh:
枪身描绘了变异老鼠试图逃离受到辐射的荧光绿色森林。

谁想尝尝当小白鼠的滋味……

9:917.desc_en:
The Operation Wildfire logo has been hand painted over a black and red base.

The nail that sticks out gets the hammer
9:917.desc_zh:
这把武器使用了自定义涂装。通体黑红的枪底上喷涂着野火大行动图标的手绘。

枪打出头鸟！

9:943.desc_en:
A custom paint job comprised of intricate teal and coral veins has been applied.

The key to an agent's heart costs $4750
9:943.desc_zh:
采用了自定义涂装，涂有复杂的水鸭蓝与珊瑚色组成的血管状图案。

击中探员心脏的秘诀价值$4750

9:975.desc_en:
The metal on this AWP has been intricately pressed with patterns of interlocking skulls.

Full tilt
9:975.desc_zh:
这把 AWP 上的金属经过精心压制，呈现细致的骷髅图案。

全力以赴
